commits.message: [Misc] Upgrade CANN(9.1.0), PTA(2.10.0.post4), and Triton(3.2.2) (#13901) ### What this PR does / why we need it? This PR upgrades the dependency stack used by the `main` branch: - Upgrade CANN from 9.0.1 to 9.1.0. - Replace the 310P 9.1.0 beta images with the 9.1.0 final images. - Synchronize A2, A3, A5, and 310P images across Ubuntu, openEuler, existing wheel builds, CI, nightly tests, and CSRC cache jobs. - Upgrade PTA (`torch-npu`) from 2.10.0.post2 to 2.10.0.post4. - Upgrade Triton Ascend from 3.2.1 to 3.2.2. - Update dependency metadata, installation documentation, Dockerfiles, CI image tags, and CANN package requirements accordingly. - Keep UVA disabled for Triton Ascend 3.2.2 because it is still affected by the pinned-memory pointer validation issue tracked in [triton-ascend#783](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton-ascend/issues/783). The platform configuration propagation change is cherry-picked from [#13799](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13799), originally authored by @yiz-liu. This change synchronizes platform-derived Ascend configuration overrides back to `vllm_config.additional_config`. This ensures that spawned EngineCore and worker processes reconstruct the effective values of `enable_npugraph_ex`, `enable_static_kernel`, and `recompute_scheduler_enable` instead of restoring stale defaults. #### GDN unit test compatibility After upgrading CANN and torch-npu, `torch_npu.npu_chunk_gated_delta_rule` becomes available and the GDN fused-op probe succeeds. This causes `test_npu_connector_observes_updated_gdn_state_after_compile` to enter the real fused CANN path instead of the mocked Triton path. The test was originally added to verify that the layerwise KV connector observes updated convolution and SSM states after eager and `torch.compile` executions. Its numerical kernels are intentionally mocked, and it uses lightweight FP32 tensors with a head dimension of 2. These inputs do not satisfy the fused CANN operator constraints, which require BF16 query inputs and production-compatible dimensions. Explicitly mock `_probe_fused_chunk()` to return `False` in this test so it continues using the mocked Triton path. This keeps the test focused on the KV connector and compilation behavior without changing production GDN behavior. - https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/31356537202/job/93361160358?pr=13901#step:17:3286 ### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change? ### How was this patch tested? - vLLM version: v0.26.0 - vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/0351e9aa1fdf1a51329d1906881528dfe61fc88e --------- Signed-off-by: MrZ20 <2609716663@qq.com>

+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-10 02:33+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-10 02:33+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# Model Runner V2 EPLB Architecture"
+msgstr "# Model Runner V2 EPLB 架构"
+
+msgid ""
+"Model Runner V2 on Ascend uses the upstream vLLM Expert Parallelism Load\n"
+"Balancer (EPLB) control plane and adds a small Ascend-specific integration\n"
+"plane. Upstream code owns load windows, policy execution, placement state, and\n"
+"the rearrangement transaction. vLLM Ascend owns device routing, executed-load\n"
+"recording, quantized expert-weight views, and HCCL communication."
+msgstr ""
+"Ascend 上的 Model Runner V2 使用上游 vLLM 专家并行负载均衡器 (EPLB) 控制平面，并添加了一个小的 Ascend "
+"特定集成平面。上游代码负责负载窗口、策略执行、放置状态和重排事务。vLLM Ascend 负责设备路由、已执行负载记录、量化专家权重视图和 HCCL "
+"通信。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This page describes the current synchronous architecture. For the decisions\n"
+"behind this ownership model, see\n"
+"[RFC #13410](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/13410). For\n"
+"user-visible configuration and the supported feature matrix, see the\n"
+"[EPLB user guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/expert_parallelism_load_balancer.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"本页描述当前的同步架构。有关此所有权模型背后的决策，请参阅 [RFC #13410](https://github.com/vllm-"
+"project/vllm-ascend/issues/13410)。有关用户可见的配置和支持的功能矩阵，请参阅 [EPLB "
+"用户指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/expert_parallelism_load_balancer.md)。"
+
+msgid "## Mental model"
+msgstr "## 心智模型"
+
+msgid "EPLB has a control plane and a data plane:"
+msgstr "EPLB 具有控制平面和数据平面："
+
+msgid ""
+"- The **control plane** decides where each logical expert is placed and when\n"
+"  the placement changes. Its source of truth is the upstream `EplbState`.\n"
+"- The **data plane** maps each token's logical expert choice to the physical\n"
+"  expert installed on the local rank, runs fused MoE, and records the experts\n"
+"  that actually executed.\n"
+"- The **movement plane** exposes the real quantized expert storage and moves it\n"
+"  through the upstream rearrangement transaction using HCCL-backed\n"
+"  `torch.distributed` collectives."
+msgstr ""
+"- **控制平面** 决定每个逻辑专家的放置位置以及放置何时更改。其事实来源是上游的 `EplbState`。\n"
+"- **数据平面** 将每个 token 的逻辑专家选择映射到本地 rank 上安装的物理专家，运行融合 MoE，并记录实际执行的专家。\n"
+"- **移动平面** 暴露真实的量化专家存储，并通过使用 HCCL 支持的 `torch.distributed` 集合的上游重排事务来移动它。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Ascend integration adapts the boundaries between these planes; it does not\n"
+"implement a second policy or placement lifecycle."
+msgstr "Ascend 集成适配了这些平面之间的边界；它不实现第二个策略或放置生命周期。"
+
+msgid "## Component boundaries"
+msgstr "## 组件边界"
+
+msgid "| Component | Responsibility |"
+msgstr "| 组件 | 职责 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Upstream `EPLBController` and `EplbState` | Load windows, policy, "
+"placement calculation, and rearrangement ordering |"
+msgstr "| 上游 `EPLBController` 和 `EplbState` | 负载窗口、策略、放置计算和重排排序 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `AscendEPLBController` | Batch load-collection-phase filtering and "
+"construction of Ascend state |"
+msgstr "| `AscendEPLBController` | 批量负载收集阶段过滤和 Ascend 状态构建 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `AscendEplbState` and `AscendEplbLayerState` | Stable device lookup "
+"derived from committed upstream placement |"
+msgstr "| `AscendEplbState` 和 `AscendEplbLayerState` | 从已提交的上游放置派生的稳定设备查找 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Router adapter | Per-instance logical-to-physical ID mapping without "
+"replacing the upstream router class |"
+msgstr "| 路由器适配器 | 每个实例的逻辑到物理 ID 映射，而不替换上游路由器类 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Fused MoE EPLB helpers | Device lookup and post-compute physical load "
+"recording |"
+msgstr "| 融合 MoE EPLB 辅助函数 | 设备查找和计算后物理负载记录 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Quantization method | View of the expert tensors and metadata actually "
+"consumed by its kernel |"
+msgstr "| 量化方法 | 其内核实际消耗的专家张量和元数据的视图 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `HcclEplbCommunicator` | Upstream communicator contract implemented "
+"through `torch.distributed` on HCCL |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `HcclEplbCommunicator` | 通过 HCCL 上的 `torch.distributed` 实现的上游通信器契约 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Platform patch | Capability adaptation and the narrow construction/commit "
+"hooks not exposed by upstream |"
+msgstr "| 平台补丁 | 能力适配以及上游未暴露的窄构建/提交钩子 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The platform patch is an entry adapter. Runtime routing, state management, and\n"
+"communication live in explicit components so that patching does not become an\n"
+"alternative implementation of EPLB."
+msgstr "平台补丁是一个入口适配器。运行时路由、状态管理和通信位于显式组件中，以便补丁不会成为 EPLB 的替代实现。"
+
+msgid "## Request and layer flow"
+msgstr "## 请求和层流程"
+
+msgid ""
+"At runner initialization, platform validation checks the Model Runner version,\n"
+"EPLB mode, quantization layout, and execution features. Unsupported\n"
+"combinations fail before serving. Model Runner V1 keeps its legacy EPLB path;\n"
+"Model Runner V2 uses the upstream control plane. V1-only controls and V2 EPLB\n"
+"configuration cannot be mixed."
+msgstr ""
+"在 runner 初始化时，平台验证检查 Model Runner 版本、EPLB 模式、量化布局和执行功能。不支持的组合在提供服务之前失败。Model"
+" Runner V1 保留其旧版 EPLB 路径；Model Runner V2 使用上游控制平面。仅限 V1 的控件和 V2 EPLB "
+"配置不能混合使用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"At the start of a Model Runner V2 batch, the runner tells\n"
+"`AscendEPLBController` whether the batch belongs to the configured load\n"
+"collection phase. The phase may collect all batches, prefill batches, or decode\n"
+"batches. A mixed batch containing prefill work is classified as prefill. This\n"
+"decision is made once per batch rather than once per token or MoE layer."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Model Runner V2 批次开始时，runner 告知 `AscendEPLBController` "
+"该批次是否属于配置的负载收集阶段。该阶段可以收集所有批次、prefill 批次或 decode 批次。包含 prefill 工作的混合批次被分类为 "
+"prefill。此决策每个批次做出一次，而不是每个 token 或 MoE 层做出一次。"
+
+msgid "Each MoE layer then follows one routing path:"
+msgstr "然后每个 MoE 层遵循一条路由路径："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. The upstream router selects logical experts and produces routing weights.\n"
+"2. The instance-bound Ascend router adapter gathers physical expert IDs from\n"
+"   the layer's device lookup.\n"
+"3. The quantization method receives the routing weights and physical IDs and\n"
+"   runs fused MoE. It does not select experts again.\n"
+"4. After compute, the local slice of executed physical expert counts is added\n"
+"   to the upstream load window when its collection phase is enabled."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 上游路由器选择逻辑专家并生成路由权重。\n"
+"2. 绑定实例的 Ascend 路由器适配器从层的设备查找中收集物理专家 ID。\n"
+"3. 量化方法接收路由权重和物理 ID 并运行融合 MoE。它不会再次选择专家。\n"
+"4. 计算后，当上游负载窗口的收集阶段启用时，已执行的物理专家计数的本地切片被添加到该窗口中。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Phase selection filters only the load submitted by a rank. Every rank still\n"
+"advances the upstream EPLB state machine and participates in its collectives in\n"
+"the same order, even when local batches belong to different phases."
+msgstr ""
+"阶段选择仅过滤由 rank 提交的负载。每个 rank 仍然以相同的顺序推进上游 EPLB 状态机并参与其集合操作，即使本地批次属于不同的阶段。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The lookup is a fixed-shape device tensor whose object identity remains stable.\n"
+"When placement changes, `AscendEplbLayerState` builds the new values and copies\n"
+"them into the existing tensor. Long-lived router instances and compiled call\n"
+"sites therefore keep a valid reference without reconstructing Python objects\n"
+"in the layer hot path."
+msgstr ""
+"查找是一个固定形状的设备张量，其对象身份保持稳定。当放置更改时，`AscendEplbLayerState` "
+"构建新值并将其复制到现有张量中。因此，长期存在的路由器实例和编译的调用点保持有效的引用，而无需在层热路径中重建 Python 对象。"
+
+msgid "## Rearrangement and weight views"
+msgstr "## 重排和权重视图"
+
+msgid ""
+"When an upstream load window closes, the controller evaluates the policy and,\n"
+"if necessary, starts the upstream rearrangement transaction. The transaction\n"
+"uses the communicator to exchange expert tensors between expert-parallel ranks,\n"
+"commits the new placement, and then refreshes the device lookup. Routing never\n"
+"observes a lookup for an uncommitted placement."
+msgstr ""
+"当上游负载窗口关闭时，控制器评估策略，并在必要时启动上游重排事务。该事务使用通信器在专家并行 rank "
+"之间交换专家张量，提交新放置，然后刷新设备查找。路由永远不会观察到未提交放置的查找。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Expert storage is quantization-specific. Some kernels consume independent\n"
+"per-expert tensors, while others consume packed tensors or associated scale and\n"
+"metadata layouts. Each supported quantization method exposes a weight view of\n"
+"the exact storage read by compute. Rearrangement operates through that view;\n"
+"it does not assume that a canonical model parameter is the active kernel\n"
+"storage."
+msgstr ""
+"专家存储是特定于量化的。某些内核消耗独立的每专家张量，而其他内核消耗打包张量或关联的缩放和元数据布局。每个受支持的量化方法都暴露了计算读取的确切存储的权重视图。重排通过该视图进行操作；它不假设规范的模型参数是活动的内核存储。"
+
+msgid "Support therefore requires all of the following for a format:"
+msgstr "因此，支持一种格式需要满足以下所有条件："
+
+msgid ""
+"- the compute tensors and coupled metadata can be identified;\n"
+"- the view preserves the ordering expected by the upstream movement contract;\n"
+"- movement updates the same storage used by the fused kernel;\n"
+"- post-move execution remains valid for repeated rearrangements."
+msgstr ""
+"- 可以识别计算张量及其关联的元数据；\n"
+"- 视图保持了上游移动契约所期望的顺序；\n"
+"- 移动更新了融合内核所使用的同一存储；\n"
+"- 移动后的执行在重复重排时仍然有效。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Formats that cannot satisfy these conditions are rejected during validation.\n"
+"The current format and execution-mode support table lives in the\n"
+"[EPLB user guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/expert_parallelism_load_balancer.md),\n"
+"not in this architecture page."
+msgstr ""
+"无法满足这些条件的格式会在验证期间被拒绝。\n"
+"当前格式和执行模式支持表位于\n"
+"[EPLB 用户指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/expert_parallelism_load_balancer.md)，\n"
+"而非本架构页面。"
+
+msgid "## Communication and synchronization"
+msgstr "## 通信与同步"
+
+msgid ""
+"`HcclEplbCommunicator` implements the upstream communicator interface through\n"
+"the process group's `torch.distributed` operations. HCCL is selected by the NPU\n"
+"process group even though the upstream configuration names its generic\n"
+"torch-distributed communicator backend. Ascend-specific capability differences,\n"
+"such as profiling-buffer reservation, stay inside the communicator."
+msgstr ""
+"`HcclEplbCommunicator` 通过进程组的 `torch.distributed` 操作实现上游通信器接口。\n"
+"即使上游配置将其通用 torch-distributed 通信器后端命名为 HCCL，\n"
+"NPU 进程组仍会选择 HCCL。Ascend 特有的能力差异，\n"
+"例如性能分析缓冲区预留，保持在通信器内部。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The supported path is synchronous: weight movement and placement commit finish\n"
+"before inference continues. Asynchronous EPLB configuration is rejected at\n"
+"startup. The layer-state refresh hook is attached to the commit boundary so a\n"
+"future asynchronous implementation can preserve the same reader guarantee,\n"
+"but it does not enable asynchronous execution today."
+msgstr ""
+"支持的路径是同步的：权重移动和放置提交在推理继续之前完成。\n"
+"异步 EPLB 配置在启动时被拒绝。层状态刷新钩子附加在提交边界上，\n"
+"以便未来的异步实现可以保持相同的读取保证，\n"
+"但目前并不启用异步执行。"
+
+msgid "## Invariants"
+msgstr "## 不变量"
+
+msgid "Changes to this integration must preserve these invariants:"
+msgstr "对此集成的更改必须保持以下不变量："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. Upstream placement state is the only source of truth for Model Runner V2.\n"
+"2. Expert selection runs once; quantized compute consumes physical expert IDs.\n"
+"3. The device lookup changes only after the corresponding placement commits.\n"
+"4. Load is recorded after compute in the physical expert ID space.\n"
+"5. Weight movement updates the exact storage used by the active quantized\n"
+"   kernel.\n"
+"6. Unsupported modes fail during initialization instead of silently degrading.\n"
+"7. EPLB-disabled execution and the Model Runner V1 EPLB path remain isolated.\n"
+"8. The routing hot path avoids host loops, device-to-host synchronization, and\n"
+"   mutable Python mapping work."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 上游放置状态是 Model Runner V2 的唯一事实来源。\n"
+"2. 专家选择只运行一次；量化计算使用物理专家 ID。\n"
+"3. 设备查找仅在相应放置提交后更改。\n"
+"4. 负载在物理专家 ID 空间中的计算后记录。\n"
+"5. 权重移动更新活动量化内核所使用的确切存储。\n"
+"6. 不支持的模式在初始化期间失败，而不是静默降级。\n"
+"7. 禁用 EPLB 的执行和 Model Runner V1 EPLB 路径保持隔离。\n"
+"8. 路由热路径避免主机循环、设备到主机同步和可变 Python 映射工作。"
+
+msgid "## Extension and debugging anchors"
+msgstr "## 扩展与调试锚点"
+
+msgid ""
+"When adding a quantization format, begin with its expert-weight view and prove\n"
+"that the fused kernel reads the moved tensors. Do not add layout knowledge to\n"
+"the controller or router. When adding an execution mode, check its placement\n"
+"commit boundary and whether router instances retain the stable lookup."
+msgstr ""
+"添加量化格式时，从其专家权重视图开始，并证明融合内核读取移动后的张量。\n"
+"不要向控制器或路由器添加布局知识。添加执行模式时，检查其放置提交边界\n"
+"以及路由器实例是否保持稳定的查找。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For stale or incorrect expert selection after rearrangement, inspect the\n"
+"committed `EplbState` and the in-place lookup refresh. For successful movement\n"
+"with unchanged model behavior, inspect the quantization-owned weight view. For\n"
+"missing or shifted load statistics, verify that counts are recorded after\n"
+"fused MoE and use physical IDs. Startup rejections should be checked against\n"
+"the user-guide support matrix and\n"
+"[additional configuration reference](../../user_guide/configuration/additional_config.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"对于重排后过时或错误的专家选择，检查已提交的 `EplbState` 和就地查找刷新。\n"
+"对于成功移动但模型行为不变的情况，检查量化拥有的权重视图。\n"
+"对于缺失或偏移的负载统计，验证计数是在融合 MoE 之后记录的，并使用物理 ID。\n"
+"启动拒绝应对照用户指南支持矩阵和\n"
+"[附加配置参考](../../user_guide/configuration/additional_config.md) 进行检查。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Repository test placement and registration rules are documented in the\n"
+"[testing guide](../contribution/testing.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"仓库测试放置和注册规则记录在\n"
+"[测试指南](../contribution/testing.md) 中。"

@@ -111,11 +111,6 @@ msgstr "## 使用 Python 进行设置"

 msgstr "首先，安装系统依赖并配置 pip 镜像源："

+msgid "## 5 Online Service Deployment {: #5-online-service-deployment }"
+msgstr "## 5 在线服务部署 {: #5-online-service-deployment }"
+
+msgid "=== \"A3 series DSpark\""
+msgstr "=== \"A3系列DSpark\""
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--max-model-len` specifies the maximum context length - that is, the sum of input and output tokens for a single request. Adjust it according to your actual scenario.\n"
+"- `--no-enable-prefix-caching` indicates that prefix caching is disabled. To enable it, remove this option.\n"
+"- `--speculative-config` configures the MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) speculative decoding to accelerate inference. When using a DSpark model, set the speculative decoding method to `dspark`.\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` enables full ACL graph execution in the decode phase to reduce scheduling latency.\n"
+"- `enable_flashcomm1` enables the FlashComm communication optimization.\n"
+"- `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL`: Controls the retention interval, in tokens, for prefix-cache checkpoints of hybrid attention layers. It is applicable to DeepSeek-V4 and takes effect only when prefix caching is enabled. Under KV-cache pressure, it can improve the effective prefix-cache hit rate for reusable long prefixes. The value must be a non-negative multiple of `--block-size`; for DeepSeek-V4-Flash, 128 times `--block-size` is recommended. Set it to `4096` when `--block-size` is `32`, or `16384` when `--block-size` is `128`."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--max-model-len`指定最大上下文长度，即单个请求的输入和输出token之和。请根据实际场景进行调整。\n"
+"- `--no-enable-prefix-caching`表示禁用前缀缓存。如需启用，请移除该选项。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config`配置MTP（多token预测）投机解码以加速推理。使用DSpark模型时，请将投机解码方法设置为`dspark`。\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`在解码阶段启用完整的ACL图执行，以减少调度延迟。\n"
+"- `enable_flashcomm1`启用FlashComm通信优化。\n"
+"- `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL`：控制混合注意力层前缀缓存检查点的保留间隔（以token为单位）。适用于DeepSeek-V4，且仅在启用前缀缓存时生效。在KV缓存压力下，可提高可复用长前缀的有效前缀缓存命中率。该值必须是`--block-size`的非负倍数；对于DeepSeek-V4-Flash，建议设置为`--block-size`的128倍。当`--block-size`为`32`时，设置为`4096`；当`--block-size`为`128`时，设置为`16384`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"=== \"A3 series with dspark\"\n"
+"    1. Prefill node"
+msgstr ""
+"=== \"A3系列与dspark\"\n"
+"    1. Prefill节点"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `enable_flashcomm1`: enables the communication optimization function on the prefill nodes.\n"
+"- `recompute_scheduler_enable: true`: enables the recomputation scheduler. When the KV Cache of the decode node is insufficient, requests will be sent to the prefill node to recompute the KV Cache. In the PD separation scenario, enable this configuration only on decode nodes.\n"
+"- `speculative-config`: When DSpark is enabled, Prefill and Decode must use the same number of speculative tokens. For MTP, we recommend setting Prefill to 1 and Decode to the actual number of speculative tokens.\n"
+"- `MooncakeHybridConnector`: the KV transfer connector used for PD separation, transferring KV Cache between prefill and decode nodes.\n"
+"- `enable_shared_expert_dp: true`: enables data parallelism for shared experts, applicable to MoE models.\n"
+"- `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL`: Controls the retention interval, in tokens, for prefix-cache checkpoints of hybrid attention layers. It is applicable to DeepSeek-V4 and takes effect only when prefix caching is enabled. Under KV-cache pressure, it can improve the effective prefix-cache hit rate for reusable long prefixes. The value must be a non-negative multiple of `--block-size`; for DeepSeek-V4-Flash, 128 times `--block-size` is recommended. Set it to `4096` when `--block-size` is `32`, or `16384` when `--block-size` is `128`."
+msgstr ""
+"- `enable_flashcomm1`：在prefill节点上启用通信优化功能。\n"
+"- `recompute_scheduler_enable: true`：启用重计算调度器。当decode节点的KV Cache不足时，请求将被发送到prefill节点以重计算KV Cache。在PD分离场景中，仅在decode节点上启用此配置。\n"
+"- `speculative-config`：启用DSpark时，Prefill和Decode必须使用相同数量的投机token。对于MTP，建议将Prefill设置为1，将Decode设置为实际的投机token数量。\n"
+"- `MooncakeHybridConnector`：用于PD分离的KV传输连接器，在prefill和decode节点之间传输KV Cache。\n"
+"- `enable_shared_expert_dp: true`：为共享专家启用数据并行，适用于MoE模型。\n"
+"- `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL`：控制混合注意力层前缀缓存检查点的保留间隔（以token为单位）。适用于DeepSeek-V4，且仅在启用前缀缓存时生效。在KV缓存压力下，可提高可复用长前缀的有效前缀缓存命中率。该值必须是`--block-size`的非负倍数；对于DeepSeek-V4-Flash，建议设置为`--block-size`的128倍。当`--block-size`为`32`时，设置为`4096`；当`--block-size`为`128`时，设置为`16384`。"
+

+msgid "## 5 Deployment"

+
+msgid ""
+"The deployment scenarios validated for this release are organized by context"
+" window size (below 1M / 1M), hardware (Atlas 800 A3 / A2), and deployment "
+"mode (single-node, multi-node co-located, Prefill-Decode disaggregation). "
+"All startup scripts below are the verified reference commands; key "
+"parameters are explained after each scenario."
+msgstr ""
+"本次发布验证的部署场景按上下文窗口大小（1M以下 / 1M）、硬件（Atlas 800 A3 / A2）和部署模式（单节点、多节点共置、Prefill-"
+"Decode分离）进行组织。以下所有启动脚本均为经过验证的参考命令；每个场景后会对关键参数进行说明。"
+
+msgid "### 5.1 Context Below 1M"
+msgstr "### 5.1 上下文低于1M"
+
+msgid "#### 5.1.1 Atlas 800 A3"
+msgstr "#### 5.1.1 Atlas 800 A3"
+
+msgid "##### 5.1.1.1 Single-Node Deployment"
+msgstr "##### 5.1.1.1 单节点部署"
+
+msgid "Key Parameter Descriptions:"
+msgstr "关键参数说明："
+
+msgid ""
+"Only the key parameters specific to this model/scenario are described below."
+" `max-model-len` and `max-num-seqs` need to be set according to the actual "
+"usage scenario."
+msgstr "以下仅描述此模型/场景特有的关键参数。`max-model-len`和`max-num-seqs`需要根据实际使用场景进行设置。"
+
+msgid "**Model-specific parameters:**"
+msgstr "**模型特有参数：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--enable-expert-parallel`: Must be enabled for the MoE architecture of GLM-5.2.\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`: Enables Ascend quantization for the w4a8c8 quantized weights.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size 2` / `--tensor-parallel-size 8`: DP2 TP8 parallelism layout, recommended to balance memory capacity and compute efficiency for the w4a8c8 weights. For low-latency scenarios, use `dp1tp16` instead and turn off expert parallel, at the cost of lower throughput.\n"
+"- `--tool-call-parser glm47` / `--reasoning-parser glm45` / `--enable-auto-tool-choice`: Enable function calling for GLM-5.2.\n"
+"- `--speculative-config '{\"num_speculative_tokens\": 3, \"method\": \"deepseek_mtp\", \"enforce_eager\": true}'`: Enables Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) speculative decoding with the DeepSeek-style MTP draft head of GLM-5.2. `num_speculative_tokens` (3-5) controls how many tokens are speculated per step; `enforce_eager: true` is required because GLM-5.2 does not support graph-mode speculative decoding.\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`: Enables graph capture for the decode phase only, improving decode performance by reducing kernel launch overhead.\n"
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2=0`: Disables the fused `dispatch_ffn_combine`/`mega_moe` operators in this scenario because they conflict with `multistream_overlap_shared_expert`; turn them on in multi-node scenarios where they are beneficial."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--enable-expert-parallel`：对于GLM-5.2的MoE架构必须启用。\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`：为w4a8c8量化权重启用Ascend量化。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size 2` / `--tensor-parallel-size 8`：DP2 TP8并行布局，推荐用于在w4a8c8权重下平衡内存容量和计算效率。对于低延迟场景，改用`dp1tp16`并关闭专家并行，但会降低吞吐量。\n"
+"- `--tool-call-parser glm47` / `--reasoning-parser glm45` / `--enable-auto-tool-choice`：为GLM-5.2启用函数调用功能。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config '{\"num_speculative_tokens\": 3, \"method\": \"deepseek_mtp\", \"enforce_eager\": true}'`：启用基于GLM-5.2的DeepSeek风格MTP草稿头的多令牌预测（MTP）投机解码。`num_speculative_tokens`（3-5）控制每步推测的令牌数量；`enforce_eager: true`是必需的，因为GLM-5.2不支持图模式投机解码。\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`：仅对解码阶段启用图捕获，通过减少内核启动开销来提升解码性能。\n"
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2=0`：在此场景中禁用融合的`dispatch_ffn_combine`/`mega_moe`算子，因为它们与`multistream_overlap_shared_expert`冲突；在多节点场景中可启用它们以获得收益。"
+
+msgid "**`--additional-config` fields (Ascend-specific optimizations):**"
+msgstr "**`--additional-config`字段（Ascend特有优化）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `\"enable_dsa_cp\": true`: Enables DSA context parallelism to accelerate long-context prefill. Since v0.21.0, DSA-CP is decoupled from FlashComm1 and must be enabled explicitly. With DSA-CP enabled, `layer_sharding` cannot include `o_proj`.\n"
+"- `\"enable_sparse_li_c8\": true`: Sparse attention optimizations of the C8 quantized model. `enable_sparse_li_c8` accelerates the layer-index (LI) sparse attention and is recommended to keep `true`; If the GPU memory is insufficient due to a long sequence length, you are advised to enable `enable_sparse_sfa_c8`.\n"
+"- `\"enable_balance_scheduling\": true`: Balance scheduling improves output throughput and reduces TPOT in the v1 scheduler. It replaces the deprecated environment variable `VLLM_ASCEND_BALANCE_SCHEDULING`; TTFT may degrade in some scenarios, and it is not recommended when Prefill-Decode is separated.\n"
+"- `\"multistream_overlap_shared_expert\": true`: Overlaps shared-expert computation on an additional stream, improving decode efficiency."
+msgstr ""
+"- `\"enable_dsa_cp\": true`：启用DSA上下文并行以加速长上下文预填充。自v0.21.0起，DSA-CP已与FlashComm1解耦，必须显式启用。启用DSA-CP后，`layer_sharding`不能包含`o_proj`。\n"
+"- `\"enable_sparse_li_c8\": true`：C8量化模型的稀疏注意力优化。`enable_sparse_li_c8`加速层索引（LI）稀疏注意力，建议保持`true`；如果因序列长度过长导致GPU内存不足，建议启用`enable_sparse_sfa_c8`。\n"
+"- `\"enable_balance_scheduling\": true`：平衡调度可提升v1调度器的输出吞吐量并降低TPOT。它取代了已弃用的环境变量`VLLM_ASCEND_BALANCE_SCHEDULING`；在某些场景下TTFT可能劣化，不建议在Prefill-Decode分离时使用。\n"
+"- `\"multistream_overlap_shared_expert\": true`：在额外的流上重叠共享专家计算，提升解码效率。"
+
+msgid "##### 5.1.1.2 Multi-Node Co-Located Deployment"
+msgstr "##### 5.1.1.2 多节点共置部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"Key Parameter Descriptions (in addition to [Single-Node "
+"Deployment](#5111-single-node-deployment)):"
+msgstr "关键参数说明（除[单节点部署](#5111-single-node-deployment)外）："
+
+msgid "**Multi-node network and data parallel configuration:**"
+msgstr "**多节点网络和数据并行配置：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `HCCL_IF_IP`, `GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME`, `TP_SOCKET_IFNAME`, `HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME`: Network interface configuration for multi-node communication. Set `nic_name` to the network interface name (obtained via `ifconfig`) and `local_ip` to the current node's IP address. These must be correctly configured on each node for successful multi-node communication.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size 4`: Total number of data parallel ranks across all nodes (2 ranks per node in this scenario).\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size-local 2`: Number of data parallel ranks on the current node.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-start-rank`: Starting rank offset for data parallel ranks on this node. Node 0 uses `0`, node 1 uses `2`.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-address`: IP address of the data parallel master node (node 0). Must match the `local_ip` of the master node.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-rpc-port 12980`: RPC port for data parallel master communication. Must be the same across all nodes.\n"
+"- `--headless`: Indicates a non-master node (used on node 1). Do not use on node 0."
+msgstr ""
+"- `HCCL_IF_IP`、`GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME`、`TP_SOCKET_IFNAME`、`HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME`：多节点通信的网络接口配置。将`nic_name`设置为网络接口名称（通过`ifconfig`获取），将`local_ip`设置为当前节点的IP地址。这些必须在每个节点上正确配置，才能实现成功的多节点通信。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size 4`：所有节点上的数据并行rank总数（此场景中每个节点2个rank）。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size-local 2`：当前节点上的数据并行rank数量。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-start-rank`：此节点上数据并行rank的起始rank偏移。节点0使用`0`，节点1使用`2`。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-address`：数据并行主节点（节点0）的IP地址。必须与主节点的`local_ip`匹配。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-rpc-port 12980`：数据并行主节点通信的RPC端口。所有节点必须相同。\n"
+"- `--headless`：表示非主节点（在节点1上使用）。不要在节点0上使用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"**Notice:**\n"
+"This scenario enables `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2=1` (fused `dispatch_ffn_combine`/`mega_moe` operators). Fused MC2 conflicts with `multistream_overlap_shared_expert` — the two optimizations must not be enabled at the same time (the runtime forcibly disables `multistream_overlap_shared_expert` when fused MC2 is on)."
+msgstr ""
+"**注意：**\n"
+"此场景启用了`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2=1`（融合的`dispatch_ffn_combine`/`mega_moe`算子）。融合MC2与`multistream_overlap_shared_expert`冲突——这两种优化不能同时启用（当融合MC2开启时，运行时强制禁用`multistream_overlap_shared_expert`）。"
+
+msgid "##### 5.1.1.3 Prefill-Decode Disaggregation"
+msgstr "##### 5.1.1.3 Prefill-Decode分离"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill-Decode disaggregation can be deployed on 4 Atlas 800 A3 (64GB × 16)."
+msgstr "Prefill-Decode分离可以部署在4台Atlas 800 A3（64GB × 16）上。"
+

+msgstr "**部署拓扑：**"
+
+msgid "|Node group|Nodes|Parallelism|Engine ports|"
+msgstr "|节点组|节点|并行度|引擎端口|"
+
+msgid "|Prefill|2 (node 0/1)|`DP4 TP8` (2 ranks per node)|9081/9082 per node|"
+msgstr "|Prefill|2（节点0/1）|`DP4 TP8`（每节点2个rank）|每节点9081/9082|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|Decode|2 (node 0/1)|`DP32 TP1` (16 ranks per node)|9900-9915 per node|"
+msgstr "|解码|2（节点0/1）|`DP32 TP1`（每节点16个rank）|每节点9900-9915|"
+
+msgid ""
+"Key Parameter Descriptions (in addition to [Single-Node "
+"Deployment](#5111-single-node-deployment) and [Multi-Node Co-Located "
+"Deployment](#5112-multi-node-co-located-deployment)):"
+msgstr "关键参数说明（除[单节点部署](#5111单节点部署)和[多节点共置部署](#5112多节点共置部署)外）："
+
+msgid "**`launch_online_dp.py` parameters:**"
+msgstr "**`launch_online_dp.py`参数：**"
+
+msgid "|Parameter|Type|Required|Default|Description|"
+msgstr "|参数|类型|必填|默认值|描述|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--dp-size`|int|Yes|-|Data parallel size (total number of DP ranks across "
+"all nodes).|"
+msgstr "|`--dp-size`|int|是|-|数据并行大小（所有节点上DP rank的总数）。|"
+
+msgid "|`--tp-size`|int|No|1|Tensor parallel size within each DP rank.|"
+msgstr "|`--tp-size`|int|否|1|每个DP rank内的张量并行大小。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--dp-size-local`|int|No|(same as `--dp-size`)|Number of DP ranks on the "
+"current node. If not set, defaults to `--dp-size`.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`--dp-size-local`|int|否|（与`--dp-size`相同）|当前节点上的DP rank数量。若未设置，默认为`--dp-"
+"size`。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--dp-rank-start`|int|No|0|Starting rank offset for data parallel ranks on "
+"this node.|"
+msgstr "|`--dp-rank-start`|int|否|0|本节点上数据并行rank的起始偏移量。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--dp-address`|str|Yes|-|IP address of the data parallel master node (node "
+"0).|"
+msgstr "|`--dp-address`|str|是|-|数据并行主节点（节点0）的IP地址。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--dp-rpc-port`|str|No|12345|RPC port for data parallel master "
+"communication.|"
+msgstr "|`--dp-rpc-port`|str|否|12345|数据并行主节点通信的RPC端口。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--vllm-start-port`|int|No|9000|Starting port for each vLLM engine instance"
+" on this node. Each DP rank's engine port = `vllm_start_port` + local rank "
+"index.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`--vllm-start-port`|int|否|9000|本节点上每个vLLM引擎实例的起始端口。每个DP rank的引擎端口 = "
+"`vllm_start_port` + 本地rank索引。|"
+
+msgid "**Prefill node-specific configurations:**"
+msgstr "**预填充节点专属配置：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1=1`: Enables FlashComm optimization to reduce communication and computation overhead on prefill nodes. With FlashComm enabled, `layer_sharding` cannot include `o_proj` as an element.\n"
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2=1`: Enables the `dispatch_ffn_combine`/`mega_moe` fused operators. Note: fused MC2 conflicts with `multistream_overlap_shared_expert`.\n"
+"- `ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1` / `ASCEND_A3_ENABLE=1`: A3-specific optimizations for operator initialization and communication aggregation.\n"
+"- `--speculative-config '{\"num_speculative_tokens\": 1, ...}'`: Minimal MTP speculation during prefill (decode nodes use a higher count, see below)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1=1`：启用FlashComm优化以减少预填充节点上的通信和计算开销。启用FlashComm后，`layer_sharding`不能包含`o_proj`作为元素。\n"
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2=1`：启用`dispatch_ffn_combine`/`mega_moe`融合算子。注意：融合MC2与`multistream_overlap_shared_expert`冲突。\n"
+"- `ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1` / `ASCEND_A3_ENABLE=1`：针对A3的算子初始化和通信聚合优化。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config '{\"num_speculative_tokens\": 1, ...}'`：预填充期间的最小MTP推测（解码节点使用更高数量，见下文）。"
+
+msgid "**Decode node-specific configurations:**"
+msgstr "**解码节点专属配置：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens 164`: Small batch token limit on decode nodes — decode processes one token per sequence per step, so batch tokens should be close to `max-num-seqs`.\n"
+"- `--speculative-config '{\"num_speculative_tokens\": 5, ...}'`: Higher MTP speculation count on decode nodes to maximize decode throughput.\n"
+"- `--additional-config '{\"recompute_scheduler_enable\": true}'`: Enables the recomputation scheduler. When the decode node KV cache is insufficient, requests are sent back to the prefill node to recompute the KV cache. Recommended on both prefill and decode nodes in PD scenarios."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens 164`：解码节点上的小批量token限制——解码每步每序列处理一个token，因此批量token数应接近`max-num-seqs`。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config '{\"num_speculative_tokens\": 5, ...}'`：解码节点上更高的MTP推测数量以最大化解码吞吐量。\n"
+"- `--additional-config '{\"recompute_scheduler_enable\": true}'`：启用重计算调度器。当解码节点KV缓存不足时，请求被发送回预填充节点以重计算KV缓存。建议在PD场景中的预填充和解码节点上均启用。"
+
+msgid "**Mooncake KV transfer configuration (`--kv-transfer-config`):**"
+msgstr "**Mooncake KV传输配置（`--kv-transfer-config`）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `\"kv_connector\": \"MooncakeConnectorV1\"`: Uses Mooncake as the KV cache transfer connector between prefill and decode nodes.\n"
+"- `\"kv_role\": \"kv_producer\"` / `\"kv_consumer\"`: `kv_producer` on prefill nodes, `kv_consumer` on decode nodes.\n"
+"- `\"kv_port\"`: Port for Mooncake KV transfer communication. Use different port ranges for prefill (`30000`) and decode (`30100`) node groups.\n"
+"- `\"use_ascend_direct\": true`: Enables Ascend direct transfer for KV cache, reducing latency.\n"
+"- `\"prefill\"` / `\"decode\"` sections: Specify the `dp_size` and `tp_size` of the prefill and decode node groups respectively. These must match the actual deployment topology (`prefill: dp4 tp8`, `decode: dp32 tp1`)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `\"kv_connector\": \"MooncakeConnectorV1\"`：使用Mooncake作为预填充和解码节点之间的KV缓存传输连接器。\n"
+"- `\"kv_role\": \"kv_producer\"` / `\"kv_consumer\"`：预填充节点上为`kv_producer`，解码节点上为`kv_consumer`。\n"
+"- `\"kv_port\"`：Mooncake KV传输通信端口。预填充（`30000`）和解码（`30100`）节点组使用不同的端口范围。\n"
+"- `\"use_ascend_direct\": true`：启用Ascend直接传输KV缓存，降低延迟。\n"
+"- `\"prefill\"` / `\"decode\"`部分：分别指定预填充和解码节点组的`dp_size`和`tp_size`。这些必须与实际部署拓扑匹配（`prefill: dp4 tp8`，`decode: dp32 tp1`）。"
+
+msgid "**Request forwarding (proxy):**"
+msgstr "**请求转发（代理）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- The proxy command maps every prefill engine endpoint (4 prefiller hosts × 2 ports per node) and every decode engine endpoint (32 decoder hosts/ports) to a single entry point on port `8000`.\n"
+"- The proxy program can be found in [load_balance_proxy_server_example.py](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/disaggregated_prefill_v1/load_balance_proxy_server_example.py)."
+msgstr ""
+"- 代理命令将每个预填充引擎端点（每节点4个预填充主机 × 2个端口）和每个解码引擎端点（32个解码主机/端口）映射到端口`8000`上的单一入口点。\n"
+"- 代理程序可在[load_balance_proxy_server_example.py](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/disaggregated_prefill_v1/load_balance_proxy_server_example.py)中找到。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Please refer to [envs.py](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-"
+"ascend/blob/main/vllm_ascend/envs.py) for further explanation and "
+"restrictions of the environment variables above."
+msgstr ""
+"请参阅[envs.py](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-"
+"ascend/blob/main/vllm_ascend/envs.py)以了解上述环境变量的进一步说明和限制。"
+
+msgid "#### 5.1.2 Atlas 800 A2"
+msgstr "#### 5.1.2 Atlas 800 A2"
+
+msgid "##### 5.1.2.1 Multi-Node Co-Located Deployment"
+msgstr "##### 5.1.2.1 多节点共置部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `GLM-5.2-w4a8c8`: can be deployed on 2 Atlas 800 A2 (64GB × 8). A single "
+"Atlas 800 A2 node (8 × 64GB) cannot fit the w4a8c8 weights, so the 2-node "
+"deployment is the minimum configuration for the A2 series."
+msgstr ""
+"- `GLM-5.2-w4a8c8`：可部署在2台Atlas 800 A2（64GB × 8）上。单台Atlas 800 A2节点（8 × "
+"64GB）无法容纳w4a8c8权重，因此2节点部署是A2系列的最低配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The A2 series uses a different optimization stack than A3: FlashComm1 and "
+"DSA-CP are not used here."
+msgstr "A2系列使用与A3不同的优化栈：此处不使用FlashComm1和DSA-CP。"
+
+msgid "**A2-specific environment variables:**"
+msgstr "**A2专属环境变量：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `CPU_AFFINITY_CONF=1`: Enables CPU core affinity binding for worker processes.\n"
+"- `ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1`: ACL operator initialization mode to speed up operator compilation.\n"
+"- `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT=360000` / `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3000` / `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=200` / `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=120` / `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=1200`: Timeout settings for multi-node startup and model execution on the slower A2 platform. Increase them if the engine fails to become ready in time."
+msgstr ""
+"- `CPU_AFFINITY_CONF=1`：为工作进程启用CPU核心亲和性绑定。\n"
+"- `ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1`：ACL算子初始化模式，加速算子编译。\n"
+"- `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT=360000` / `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3000` / `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=200` / `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=120` / `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=1200`：针对较慢的A2平台的多节点启动和模型执行超时设置。若引擎未能及时就绪，请增大这些值。"
+
+msgid "##### 5.1.2.2 Prefill-Decode Disaggregation"
+msgstr "##### 5.1.2.2 预填充-解码分离"
+
+msgid ""
+"On Atlas 800 A2, where each node exposes 8 cards, the same global P/D "
+"topology (Prefill `DP4 TP8`, Decode `DP8 TP4`) is split across 8 nodes: 4 "
+"prefill nodes hosting 1 DP rank each (8 cards per rank), and 4 decode nodes "
+"hosting 2 DP ranks each (4 cards per rank). The `launch_online_dp.py` above "
+"is reused as-is. The prefill side enables FlashComm1 and DSA CP; the decode "
+"side enables MLAPO and `DYNAMIC_EPLB` with a `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph. Both "
+"sides enable prefix caching and MTP (`num_speculative_tokens=1` on prefill, "
+"`3` on decode). All IPs, NIC names, ports and weight paths below are "
+"placeholders."
+msgstr ""
+"在Atlas 800 A2上，每个节点暴露8张卡，相同的全局P/D拓扑（预填充`DP4 TP8`，解码`DP8 "
+"TP4`）被拆分到8个节点：4个预填充节点各承载1个DP rank（每rank 8张卡），4个解码节点各承载2个DP rank（每rank "
+"4张卡）。上述`launch_online_dp.py`按原样复用。预填充侧启用FlashComm1和DSA "
+"CP；解码侧启用MLAPO和带`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`图的`DYNAMIC_EPLB`。两侧均启用前缀缓存和MTP（预填充上`num_speculative_tokens=1`，解码上`3`）。以下所有IP、网卡名称、端口和权重路径均为占位符。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Please refer to the [KV Cache Pool (Ascend Store) Deployment "
+"Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-"
+"cn/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/kv_pool.html) for the KV Cache Pool "
+"startup method and the Mooncake configuration file."
+msgstr ""
+"KV Cache Pool（Ascend Store）的启动方法及Mooncake配置文件请参考[KV Cache Pool（Ascend "
+"Store）部署指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-"
+"cn/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/kv_pool.html)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Key Parameter Descriptions (in addition to [Prefill-Decode "
+"Disaggregation](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)):"
+msgstr "关键参数说明（除[预填充-解码分离](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)外）："
+
+msgid ""
+"This 8-node A2 layout splits the global P/D topology across 8 Atlas 800 A2 "
+"nodes: 4 prefill nodes hosting 1 DP rank each (8 cards per rank, `DP4 TP8`) "
+"and 4 decode nodes hosting 2 DP ranks each (4 cards per rank, `DP8 TP4`). "
+"The `launch_online_dp.py` script is the same as in [Prefill-Decode "
+"Disaggregation](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)."
+msgstr ""
+"该8节点A2布局将全局P/D拓扑分布到8个Atlas 800 A2节点上：4个预填充节点各承载1个DP rank（每个rank 8张卡，`DP4 "
+"TP8`），4个解码节点各承载2个DP rank（每个rank 4张卡，`DP8 TP4`）。`launch_online_dp.py`脚本与[预填充-"
+"解码分离](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)中的相同。"
+
+msgid "**Prefill node-specific configurations (A2):**"
+msgstr "**预填充节点特定配置（A2）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--additional-config '{\"enable_sparse_sfa_c8\": true, "
+"\"enable_sparse_li_c8\": true, ...}'`: Both SFA C8 optimizations are enabled"
+" in this scenario (vs. `enable_sparse_sfa_c8: false` in the A3 co-located "
+"scenarios)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--additional-config '{\"enable_sparse_sfa_c8\": true, "
+"\"enable_sparse_li_c8\": true, ...}'`：此场景中启用了两个SFA "
+"C8优化（而A3共置场景中为`enable_sparse_sfa_c8: false`）。"
+
+msgid "**Decode node-specific configurations (A2):**"
+msgstr "**解码节点特定配置（A2）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO=1`: MLAPO fusion on decode nodes for memory-bandwidth-bound token generation.\n"
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens 256`: Small batch token limit on decode nodes."
+msgstr ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO=1`：在解码节点上启用MLAPO融合，用于内存带宽受限的token生成。\n"
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens 256`：解码节点上的小批量token限制。"
+
+msgid ""
+"**Multi-connector KV transfer configuration (`--kv-transfer-config`):**"
+msgstr "**多连接器KV传输配置（`--kv-transfer-config`）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `\"kv_connector\": \"MultiConnector\"`: Combines multiple KV transfer connectors.\n"
+"- `MooncakeConnectorV1`: Mooncake KV cache transfer between prefill and decode nodes (same role as in [Prefill-Decode Disaggregation](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)).\n"
+"- `AscendStoreConnector`: The KV Cache Pool (Ascend Store) connector, available since v0.23.0 — see the [KV Cache Pool (Ascend Store) Deployment Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/kv_pool.html).\n"
+"- `\"kv_load_failure_policy\": \"recompute\"`: When a KV block fails to load from the KV pool, the request falls back to recomputation instead of failing.\n"
+"- `\"load_async\": true` (decode side): Asynchronously loads KV cache from the pool on decode nodes.\n"
+"- `\"backend\": \"mooncake\"`: The Ascend Store backend used by the connector."
+msgstr ""
+"- `\"kv_connector\": \"MultiConnector\"`：组合多个KV传输连接器。\n"
+"- `MooncakeConnectorV1`：预填充节点与解码节点之间的Mooncake KV缓存传输（与[预填充-解码分离](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)中的角色相同）。\n"
+"- `AscendStoreConnector`：KV Cache Pool（Ascend Store）连接器，自v0.23.0起可用——参见[KV Cache Pool（Ascend Store）部署指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/kv_pool.html)。\n"
+"- `\"kv_load_failure_policy\": \"recompute\"`：当从KV池加载KV块失败时，请求回退到重计算而不是失败。\n"
+"- `\"load_async\": true`（解码侧）：在解码节点上异步从池中加载KV缓存。\n"
+"- `\"backend\": \"mooncake\"`：连接器使用的Ascend Store后端。"
+
+msgid "**Environment variables for the A2 PD scenario:**"
+msgstr "**A2 PD场景的环境变量：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `VLLM_USE_V1=1`: Forces the v1 scheduler.\n"
+"- `ASCEND_AGGREGATE_ENABLE=1` / `ASCEND_TRANSPORT_PRINT=1`: Communication aggregation and transport debug printing.\n"
+"- `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`: Fixed hash seed for reproducible distributed scheduling.\n"
+"- `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH=\"/mnt/share/scripts/mooncake.json\"`: Path to the Mooncake configuration file (must exist on each node).\n"
+"- `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1`: Enables HCCL intra-node communication over RoCE.\n"
+"- `ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1`: ACL operator initialization mode.\n"
+"- `VLLM_HOST_IP=$local_ip`: Host IP advertised by the decode engine for cross-node communication."
+msgstr ""
+"- `VLLM_USE_V1=1`：强制使用v1调度器。\n"
+"- `ASCEND_AGGREGATE_ENABLE=1` / `ASCEND_TRANSPORT_PRINT=1`：通信聚合和传输调试打印。\n"
+"- `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`：固定哈希种子，用于可复现的分布式调度。\n"
+"- `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH=\"/mnt/share/scripts/mooncake.json\"`：Mooncake配置文件路径（每个节点上必须存在）。\n"
+"- `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1`：启用通过RoCE的HCCL节点内通信。\n"
+"- `ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1`：ACL算子初始化模式。\n"
+"- `VLLM_HOST_IP=$local_ip`：解码引擎为跨节点通信通告的主机IP。"
+
+msgid "### 5.2 1M Context Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.2 1M上下文部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"The 1M context scenarios are validated on Atlas 800 A3 only; the A2 series "
+"is not validated for 1M context."
+msgstr "1M上下文场景仅在Atlas 800 A3上验证；A2系列未针对1M上下文进行验证。"
+
+msgid "#### 5.2.1 Single-Node 1M Deployment"
+msgstr "#### 5.2.1 单节点1M部署"
+
+msgid "**1M-specific environment variables:**"
+msgstr "**1M特定环境变量：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_NZ=1`: Enables NZ format memory layout for the C8 quantized tensors, required for the 1M context deployment.\n"
+"- `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn`: Uses the spawn start method for multi-process workers (required in this scenario)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_NZ=1`：为C8量化张量启用NZ格式内存布局，1M上下文部署必需。\n"
+"- `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn`：对多进程worker使用spawn启动方法（此场景必需）。"
+
+msgid "**1M-specific vllm serve parameters:**"
+msgstr "**1M特定vllm serve参数：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1` / `--pipeline-parallel-size 1` / `--tensor-parallel-size 16`: Single-node parallelism layout `DP1 PP1 TP16`.\n"
+"- `--prefill-context-parallel-size 1` / `--decode-context-parallel-size 16`: Decode context parallelism (DCP) of 16 for the decode phase; prefill uses PCP 1.\n"
+"- `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 128`: KV cache interleave size for context parallelism."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1` / `--pipeline-parallel-size 1` / `--tensor-parallel-size 16`：单节点并行布局`DP1 PP1 TP16`。\n"
+"- `--prefill-context-parallel-size 1` / `--decode-context-parallel-size 16`：解码阶段使用16的解码上下文并行（DCP）；预填充使用PCP 1。\n"
+"- `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 128`：上下文并行的KV缓存交错大小。"
+
+msgid "#### 5.2.2 Dual-Node Co-Located 1M Deployment"
+msgstr "#### 5.2.2 双节点共置1M部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"Key Parameter Descriptions (in addition to [Single-Node 1M "
+"Deployment](#521-single-node-1m-deployment)):"
+msgstr "关键参数说明（除[单节点1M部署](#521-single-node-1m-deployment)外）："
+
+msgid "**Multi-node configuration:**"
+msgstr "**多节点配置：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 4` / `--data-parallel-size-local 2` / `--data-parallel-start-rank`: Node 0 uses `data_parallel_start_rank=0` with `server_role_args=\"--api-server-count 1\"`; node 1 uses `data_parallel_start_rank=2` with `server_role_args=\"--headless\"`.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-address $node_0_ip` / `--data-parallel-rpc-port 16591`: Data parallel master node IP and RPC port, identical on both nodes.\n"
+"- `--tensor-parallel-size 8` / `--decode-context-parallel-size 8`: `DP4 TP8 DCP8` layout — each node hosts 2 DP ranks × TP8."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 4` / `--data-parallel-size-local 2` / `--data-parallel-start-rank`：节点0使用`data_parallel_start_rank=0`并带`server_role_args=\"--api-server-count 1\"`；节点1使用`data_parallel_start_rank=2`并带`server_role_args=\"--headless\"`。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-address $node_0_ip` / `--data-parallel-rpc-port 16591`：数据并行主节点IP和RPC端口，两个节点上相同。\n"
+"- `--tensor-parallel-size 8` / `--decode-context-parallel-size 8`：`DP4 TP8 DCP8`布局——每个节点承载2个DP rank × TP8。"
+
+msgid "#### 5.2.3 PD Disaggregation 1M Deployment"
+msgstr "#### 5.2.3 PD分离1M部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"Key Parameter Descriptions (in addition to [Prefill-Decode "
+"Disaggregation](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation) and [Single-Node 1M "
+"Deployment](#521-single-node-1m-deployment)):"
+msgstr ""
+"关键参数说明（除[预填充-解码分离](#5113-prefill-decode-"
+"disaggregation)和[单节点1M部署](#521-single-node-1m-deployment)外）："
+
+msgid "**Prefill nodes (1M):**"
+msgstr "**预填充节点（1M）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--additional-config '{\"recompute_scheduler_enable\": true, ...}'`: The recompute scheduler is enabled on both prefill and decode nodes in this scenario.\n"
+"- `--kv-transfer-config`: Mooncake connector as `kv_producer` with `prefill: dp4 tp8` / `decode: dp4 tp8` (matching the 1M P/D topology, in contrast to `dp32 tp1` decode in the sub-1M PD scenario)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--additional-config '{\"recompute_scheduler_enable\": true, ...}'`：此场景中预填充和解码节点均启用重计算调度器。\n"
+"- `--kv-transfer-config`：Mooncake连接器作为`kv_producer`，使用`prefill: dp4 tp8` / `decode: dp4 tp8`（与1M P/D拓扑匹配，不同于sub-1M PD场景中的`dp32 tp1`解码）。"
+
+msgid "**Decode nodes (1M):**"
+msgstr "**解码节点（1M）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens 128`: Decode nodes store the large 1M KV cache received from prefill nodes.\n"
+"- `--kv-transfer-config`: Mooncake connector as `kv_consumer` (`kv_port: 30100`)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens 128`：解码节点存储从预填充节点接收的大型1M KV缓存。\n"
+"- `--kv-transfer-config`：Mooncake连接器作为`kv_consumer`（`kv_port: 30100`）。"

+msgid "### 9.1 Recommended Configurations"
+msgstr "### 9.1 推荐配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"> **Note**: The following configurations are validated in specific test "
+"environments and are for reference only. The optimal configuration depends "
+"on factors such as maximum input/output length, prefix cache hit rate, "
+"precision requirements, and deployment machine ratios. It is recommended to "
+"refer to [Tuning Guidelines](#92-tuning-guidelines) for tuning based on "
+"actual conditions."
+msgstr ""
+"> "
+"**注意**：以下配置在特定测试环境中验证通过，仅供参考。最佳配置取决于最大输入/输出长度、前缀缓存命中率、精度要求以及部署机器比例等因素。建议参考[调优指南](#92-tuning-"
+"guidelines)根据实际情况进行调优。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The tables below provide recommended parameter configurations for different "
+"deployment scenarios. All scenarios are categorized by use case (Low "
+"Latency, High Throughput, Long Context) and correspond to the deployment "
+"modes documented in [Deployment](#5-deployment)."
+msgstr ""
+"下表提供了不同部署场景下的推荐参数配置。所有场景按用途（低延迟、高吞吐、长上下文）分类，并对应[部署](#5-deployment)章节中记录的部署模式。"
+
+msgid "#### 9.1.1 Table 1: Scenario Overview"
+msgstr "#### 9.1.1 表1：场景概览"
+
+msgid ""
+"> `*Total NPUs` indicates the total number of NPUs used across all nodes. 1 "
+"node = 1 Atlas 800 A3 server (64G × 16 NPUs) or 1 Atlas 800 A2 server (64G ×"
+" 8 NPUs)."
+msgstr ""
+"> `*NPU总数`表示所有节点使用的NPU总数。1个节点 = 1台Atlas 800 A3服务器（64G × 16 NPU）或1台Atlas 800 "
+"A2服务器（64G × 8 NPU）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"|Scenario|Deployment Mode|*Total NPUs|Weight Version|Key Considerations|"
+msgstr "|场景|部署模式|*NPU总数|权重版本|关键考虑因素|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|Low Latency<br>(64K input)|Dual-Node Co-Located (A3), [Multi-Node Co-"
+"Located Deployment](#5112-multi-node-co-located-deployment)|32 "
+"(A3)|w4a8c8|dp2 tp16, MTP3, max-num-seqs 8, max-model-len 135000, "
+"FlashComm1, DSA CP|"
+msgstr ""
+"|低延迟<br>（64K输入）|双节点共置（A3），[多节点共置部署](#5112-multi-node-co-located-"
+"deployment)|32 (A3)|w4a8c8|dp2 tp16, MTP3, max-num-seqs 8, max-model-len "
+"135000, FlashComm1, DSA CP|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|Low Latency<br>(128K input)|Dual-Node Co-Located (A3), [Multi-Node Co-"
+"Located Deployment](#5112-multi-node-co-located-deployment)|32 "
+"(A3)|w4a8c8|dp2 tp16, MTP3, max-num-seqs 8, max-model-len 135000, "
+"FlashComm1, DSA CP|"
+msgstr ""
+"|低延迟<br>（128K输入）|双节点共置（A3），[多节点共置部署](#5112-multi-node-co-located-"
+"deployment)|32 (A3)|w4a8c8|dp2 tp16, MTP3, max-num-seqs 8, max-model-len "
+"135000, FlashComm1, DSA CP|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|High Throughput<br>(64K input)|Dual-Node Co-Located (A3), [Multi-Node Co-"
+"Located Deployment](#5112-multi-node-co-located-deployment)|32 "
+"(A3)|w4a8c8|dp4 tp8, fused MC2, MTP3, max-num-seqs 16, max-model-len 66000, "
+"FlashComm1, DSA CP|"
+msgstr ""
+"|高吞吐<br>（64K输入）|双节点共置（A3），[多节点共置部署](#5112-multi-node-co-located-"
+"deployment)|32 (A3)|w4a8c8|dp4 tp8, fused MC2, MTP3, max-num-seqs 16, max-"
+"model-len 66000, FlashComm1, DSA CP|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|High Throughput|PD Disaggregation (A3), [Prefill-Decode "
+"Disaggregation](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)|4 nodes (A3)|w4a8c8|P: "
+"dp4 tp8 (max-num-seqs 64, max-num-batched-tokens 8192, MTP1); D: dp32 tp1 "
+"(max-num-seqs 32, max-num-batched-tokens 164, MTP5), max-model-len 133120, "
+"dedicated P/D nodes, Mooncake KV transfer|"
+msgstr ""
+"|高吞吐|PD分离（A3），[预填充-解码分离](#5113-prefill-decode-disaggregation)|4节点 "
+"(A3)|w4a8c8|P：dp4 tp8（max-num-seqs 64, max-num-batched-tokens 8192, "
+"MTP1）；D：dp32 tp1（max-num-seqs 32, max-num-batched-tokens 164, MTP5），max-"
+"model-len 133120，专用P/D节点，Mooncake KV传输|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|Long Context<br>(1M)|PD Disaggregation (A3), [PD Disaggregation 1M "
+"Deployment](#523-pd-disaggregation-1m-deployment)|4 nodes (A3)|w4a8c8|P/D: "
+"dp4 tp8, DCP8, max-model-len 1040000, Mooncake KV transfer|"
+msgstr ""
+"|长上下文<br>（1M）|PD分离（A3），[PD分离1M部署](#523-pd-disaggregation-1m-deployment)|4节点 "
+"(A3)|w4a8c8|P/D：dp4 tp8, DCP8, max-model-len 1040000, Mooncake KV传输|"
+
+msgid "#### 9.1.2 Table 2: Detailed Node Configuration"
+msgstr "#### 9.1.2 表2：详细节点配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"> The TP/DP columns show the values **per node** as configured in the "
+"Deployment scripts (a node hosting 2 DP ranks of TP8, or 1 DP rank of TP16, "
+"uses 16 NPUs)."
+msgstr ""
+"> TP/DP列显示部署脚本中配置的**每节点**值（一个承载2个TP8 DP rank或1个TP16 DP rank的节点使用16个NPU）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"**Notice:**\n"
+"`max-model-len` and `max-num-seqs` need to be set according to the actual usage scenario. For other settings, please refer to the **[Deployment](#5-deployment)** chapter."
+msgstr ""
+"**注意：**\n"
+"`max-model-len`和`max-num-seqs`需要根据实际使用场景进行设置。其他设置请参考**[部署](#5-deployment)**章节。"
+
+msgid ""
+"|Scenario|Configuration|NPUs (per node)|TP|DP (per node)|Max Num Seqs|Max "
+"Num Batched Tokens|Max Model Len|MTP Spec Num|"
+msgstr ""
+"|场景|配置|NPU（每节点）|TP|DP（每节点）|Max Num Seqs|Max Num Batched Tokens|Max Model "
+"Len|MTP Spec Num|"
+
+msgid ""
+"> On PD decode nodes, `--max-num-batched-tokens` is configured as `(MTP Spec Num + 1) × Max Num Seqs` — each sequence generates one target token plus the speculated MTP tokens per decode step.\n"
+">\n"
+"> For complete startup commands and detailed parameter descriptions, please refer to the deployment examples and Key Parameter Descriptions in [Deployment](#5-deployment)."
+msgstr ""
+"> 在PD解码节点上，`--max-num-batched-tokens`配置为`(MTP Spec Num + 1) × Max Num Seqs`——每个序列在每个解码步骤生成一个目标token加上推测的MTP token。\n"
+">\n"
+"> 完整的启动命令和详细参数说明，请参考[部署](#5-deployment)章节中的部署示例和关键参数说明。"
+
+msgid "#### 9.1.3 Table 3: Performance-Related Parameter Tuning Guide"
+msgstr "#### 9.1.3 表3：性能相关参数调优指南"
+
+msgid "|Parameter|Low Latency|High Throughput|Long Context|Description|"
+msgstr "|参数|低延迟|高吞吐|长上下文|描述|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--max-num-batched-tokens`|Lower (4096–8192)|Higher for prefill "
+"(8192)|Higher for prefill (16384)|Controls batch size per step. Lower values"
+" reduce per-step latency; higher values improve prefill throughput.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`--max-num-batched-"
+"tokens`|较低（4096–8192）|预填充较高（8192）|预填充较高（16384）|控制每步的批处理大小。较低的值降低每步延迟；较高的值提升预填充吞吐。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`--gpu-memory-utilization`|0.92–0.95|0.90–0.95|0.75–0.93|NPU memory "
+"fraction. 1M scenarios must reserve memory for the huge KV cache, so use "
+"lower values (0.75–0.80 on prefill/co-located).|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`--gpu-memory-"
+"utilization`|0.92–0.95|0.90–0.95|0.75–0.93|NPU内存比例。1M场景必须为巨大的KV缓存预留内存，因此使用较低的值（预填充/共置节点上为0.75–0.80）。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`num_speculative_tokens` (MTP)|3–5|3–5|1 (prefill) / 3 (decode)|MTP "
+"speculation count. Higher values improve decode throughput at the cost of "
+"memory for the draft model KV cache. Use `1` on prefill nodes in PD mode.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`num_speculative_tokens` (MTP)|3–5|3–5|1（预填充）/ "
+"3（解码）|MTP推测数量。较高的值以草稿模型KV缓存内存为代价提升解码吞吐。PD模式下预填充节点使用`1`。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`enable_dsa_cp`|Optional|Enable (prefill nodes)|Enable (prefill nodes)|DSA "
+"context parallelism accelerates long-context prefill. Decoupled from "
+"FlashComm1 since v0.21.0.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`enable_dsa_cp`|可选|启用（预填充节点）|启用（预填充节点）|DSA上下文并行加速长上下文预填充。自v0.21.0起与FlashComm1解耦。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`enable_sparse_sfa_c8` / `enable_sparse_li_c8`|`false` / `true`|`true` / "
+"`true` (PD, 1M)|`true` / `true`|SFA optimizations for the C8 quantized "
+"model. `enable_sparse_li_c8` is always recommended; `enable_sparse_sfa_c8` "
+"(SFA DCP, since v0.23.0) benefits long-context prefill.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`enable_sparse_sfa_c8` / `enable_sparse_li_c8`|`false` / `true`|`true` / "
+"`true`（PD, 1M）|`true` / "
+"`true`|针对C8量化模型的SFA优化。始终推荐启用`enable_sparse_li_c8`；`enable_sparse_sfa_c8`（SFA"
+" DCP，自v0.23.0起）有利于长上下文预填充。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`enable_balance_scheduling`|Enable (single-node)|Enable|Disable in PD "
+"mode|Improves output throughput and reduces TPOT in the v1 scheduler. TTFT "
+"may degrade in some scenarios; not recommended when Prefill-Decode is "
+"separated.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`enable_balance_scheduling`|启用（单节点）|启用|PD模式下禁用|在v1调度器中提升输出吞吐并降低TPOT。某些场景下TTFT可能劣化；预填充-"
+"解码分离时不推荐使用。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1`|1|1 (prefill nodes)|1 (prefill "
+"nodes)|Communication optimization. Conflicts with `layer_sharding` "
+"containing `o_proj`.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1`|1|1（预填充节点）|1（预填充节点）|通信优化。与包含`o_proj`的`layer_sharding`冲突。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO`|—|1 (A2 P/D nodes)|—|Fusion operator that "
+"significantly improves performance but consumes more NPU memory. On A3 used "
+"on decode nodes only.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO`|—|1（A2 "
+"P/D节点）|—|融合算子，显著提升性能但消耗更多NPU内存。在A3上仅用于解码节点。|"
+
+msgid ""
+"|`cudagraph_mode`|FULL_DECODE_ONLY|FULL_DECODE_ONLY "
+"(decode)|FULL_DECODE_ONLY (decode)|Graph capture for the decode phase only. "
+"Prefill nodes in PD mode use `--enforce-eager` instead.|"
+msgstr ""
+"|`cudagraph_mode`|FULL_DECODE_ONLY|FULL_DECODE_ONLY（解码）|FULL_DECODE_ONLY（解码）|仅对解码阶段进行图捕获。PD模式下的预填充节点改用`--enforce-"
+"eager`。|"
+

+msgid "# MiniMax-M3"
+msgstr "# MiniMax-M3"
+
+msgid "## 1 Introduction"
+msgstr "## 1 简介"
+
+msgid ""
+"MiniMax-M3 is a multimodal large language model that supports text, image, "
+"and video inputs. On Ascend, it supports BF16 and W8A8 deployment, thinking "
+"mode, reasoning parsing, tool-call parsing, and multimodal inputs."
+msgstr ""
+"MiniMax-M3 是一个支持文本、图像和视频输入的多模态大语言模型。在昇腾上，它支持 BF16 和 W8A8 "
+"部署、思考模式、推理解析、工具调用解析以及多模态输入。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This document covers supported features, environment and model preparation, "
+"single-node deployment, multi-node deployment, thinking and parser "
+"configuration, functional verification, accuracy evaluation, and "
+"troubleshooting."
+msgstr "本文档涵盖支持的特性、环境和模型准备、单节点部署、多节点部署、思考与解析器配置、功能验证、精度评估以及故障排查。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This document is written based on the latest vLLM-Ascend version. This model"
+" is supported on the main branch."
+msgstr "本文档基于最新的 vLLM-Ascend 版本编写。该模型在 main 分支上受支持。"
+
+msgid "## 2 Supported Features"
+msgstr "## 2 支持的特性"

+msgid "### 5.3 Multimodal and ViT DP (Optional)"

+
+msgid ""
+"MiniMax-M3 supports image and video inputs on Ascend. The deployment "

+"tuned for the single-image path."

+"MiniMax-M3 在昇腾上支持图像和视频输入。上述部署示例将 `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1}'` "

+
+msgid ""
+"For the ViT / multimodal encoder part, data parallel execution is supported "

+"默认部署示例中未启用此选项，因为它可能会增加每卡内存使用量。启用 ViT DP 时，请针对目标工作负载重新评估内存相关参数，例如 `--max-"
+"model-len`、`--max-num-seqs` 和 `--gpu-memory-utilization`。"

+msgid ""
+"For video or mixed image-video requests, adjust the multimodal limit "
+"according to the actual request shape instead of changing the default "

+msgstr "对于视频或图像-视频混合请求，请根据实际请求形态调整多模态限制，而不是盲目更改默认模板："
+
+msgid ""
+"When using local media paths in requests, such as "
+"`file:///path/to/video.mp4`, add an explicit allowlist path:"
+msgstr "当在请求中使用本地媒体路径（例如 `file:///path/to/video.mp4`）时，请添加显式的白名单路径："
+
+msgid ""
+"If the number of sampled video frames is not specified, vLLM uses its "

+"`additional_config.enable_flashcomm1` 启用，而仅语言模型模式通过 `--language-model-only` "
+"启用。"

+msgid "## 6 Thinking and Parser Configuration"
+msgstr "## 6 思考与解析器配置"
+
+msgid "### 6.1 Thinking Mode"
+msgstr "### 6.1 思考模式"
+
+msgid ""
+"MiniMax-M3 supports three thinking modes, controlled via `thinking_mode` in "
+"`chat_template_kwargs`:"
+msgstr "MiniMax-M3 支持三种思考模式，通过 `chat_template_kwargs` 中的 `thinking_mode` 控制："
+
+msgid "| Mode | Behavior | Use Case |"
+msgstr "| 模式 | 行为 | 使用场景 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `enabled` | The model thinks before every response, including after tool "
+"results | Complex reasoning, agents |"
+msgstr "| `enabled` | 模型在每次响应前进行思考，包括在工具结果之后 | 复杂推理、智能体 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `disabled` | No thinking; the model answers directly | Latency-sensitive "
+"turns |"
+msgstr "| `disabled` | 不进行思考；模型直接回答 | 对延迟敏感的轮次 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `adaptive` | The model decides whether to think based on the task (default"
+" when unset) | General use |"
+msgstr "| `adaptive` | 模型根据任务决定是否思考（未设置时的默认值） | 一般用途 |"
+
+msgid "#### 6.1.1 Request Examples"
+msgstr "#### 6.1.1 请求示例"
+
+msgid "**With thinking disabled (curl):**"
+msgstr "**禁用思考（curl）：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Change `\"thinking_mode\"` to `\"enabled\"` or `\"adaptive\"` as needed. The"
+" deprecated `enable_thinking` parameter (equivalent to `thinking_mode: "
+"\"enabled\"`) is also supported."
+msgstr ""
+"根据需要将 `\"thinking_mode\"` 更改为 `\"enabled\"` 或 `\"adaptive\"`。已弃用的 "
+"`enable_thinking` 参数（等同于 `thinking_mode: \"enabled\"`）也受支持。"
+
+msgid "**With thinking enabled (Python SDK):**"
+msgstr "**启用思考（Python SDK）：**"
+
+msgid "### 6.2 Reasoning Parser"
+msgstr "### 6.2 推理解析器"
+
+msgid ""
+"The MiniMax-M3 reasoning parser (`--reasoning-parser minimax_m3`) extracts "
+"the thinking block `<mm:think>...</mm:think>` from model output and exposes "
+"it as the `reasoning` field. The remaining text is returned as `content`."
+msgstr ""
+"MiniMax-M3 推理解析器（`--reasoning-parser minimax_m3`）从模型输出中提取思考块 "
+"`<mm:think>...</mm:think>`，并将其作为 `reasoning` 字段暴露。其余文本作为 `content` 返回。"
+
+msgid "#### 6.2.1 Server Configuration"
+msgstr "#### 6.2.1 服务器配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"The `--reasoning-parser minimax_m3` flag enables the MiniMax-M3 reasoning "
+"parser, which splits model output into reasoning and content using "
+"`<mm:think>...</mm:think>` delimiters:"
+msgstr ""
+"`--reasoning-parser minimax_m3` 标志启用 MiniMax-M3 推理解析器，该解析器使用 "
+"`<mm:think>...</mm:think>` 分隔符将模型输出拆分为推理和内容："
+
+msgid "#### 6.2.2 Output Format"
+msgstr "#### 6.2.2 输出格式"
+
+msgid "MiniMax-M3 uses explicit thinking delimiters:"
+msgstr "MiniMax-M3 使用显式的思考分隔符："
+
+msgid "#### 6.2.3 Parser Behavior"
+msgstr "#### 6.2.3 解析器行为"
+
+msgid ""
+"- **`thinking_mode=\"enabled\"`**: The chat template pre-fills `<mm:think>` in the prompt. Generated text starts inside the reasoning block and transitions to content after `</mm:think>`.\n"
+"- **`thinking_mode=\"disabled\"` or default**: Model output is treated as plain content. If `<mm:think>` appears, the parser splits on the delimiters.\n"
+"- **Streaming**: Reasoning and content are streamed incrementally via `DeltaMessage.reasoning` and `DeltaMessage.content` token-by-token.\n"
+"- **Token counting**: Reasoning tokens inside `<mm:think>` blocks are correctly counted."
+msgstr ""
+"- **`thinking_mode=\"enabled\"`**：聊天模板在提示中预填充 `<mm:think>`。生成的文本从推理块内部开始，并在 `</mm:think>` 之后过渡到内容。\n"
+"- **`thinking_mode=\"disabled\"` 或默认**：模型输出被视为纯内容。如果出现 `<mm:think>`，解析器将根据分隔符进行拆分。\n"
+"- **流式输出**：推理和内容通过 `DeltaMessage.reasoning` 和 `DeltaMessage.content` 逐 token 增量流式传输。\n"
+"- **Token 计数**：`<mm:think>` 块内的推理 token 会被正确计数。"
+
+msgid "### 6.3 Tool Call Parser"
+msgstr "### 6.3 工具调用解析器"
+
+msgid ""
+"MiniMax-M3 uses a namespace-delimited XML format for tool calls. Enable it "
+"with `--tool-parser minimax_m3`."
+msgstr "MiniMax-M3 使用命名空间分隔的 XML 格式进行工具调用。通过 `--tool-parser minimax_m3` 启用。"
+
+msgid "#### 6.3.1 Server Configuration"
+msgstr "#### 6.3.1 服务器配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"When both `--reasoning-parser minimax_m3` and `--tool-call-parser "
+"minimax_m3` are specified, the parsers work together automatically to handle"
+" responses that contain both reasoning blocks and tool calls:"
+msgstr ""
+"当同时指定 `--reasoning-parser minimax_m3` 和 `--tool-call-parser minimax_m3` "
+"时，解析器会自动协同工作，处理同时包含推理块和工具调用的响应："
+
+msgid "#### 6.3.2 Tool Call Format"
+msgstr "#### 6.3.2 工具调用格式"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each structural tag is preceded by the `]<]minimax[>[` namespace marker:"
+msgstr "每个结构标签前都有 `]<]minimax[>[` 命名空间标记："
+
+msgid "#### 6.3.3 Key Features"
+msgstr "#### 6.3.3 主要特性"
+
+msgid ""
+"- **Recursive parameter parsing**: Supports nested objects and arrays (e.g., `shipping` containing `city`/`zip`).\n"
+"- **Schema-aware type coercion**: String parameter values are automatically converted to the correct types (integer, boolean, object, array) based on the function's JSON Schema definition.\n"
+"- **Multiple invocations**: A single `<tool_call>` block can contain multiple `<invoke>` blocks.\n"
+"- **Streaming**: Tool name and argument fragments are streamed incrementally as the `<invoke>` block is received."
+msgstr ""
+"- **递归参数解析**：支持嵌套对象和数组（例如，包含 `city`/`zip` 的 `shipping`）。\n"
+"- **模式感知类型转换**：根据函数的 JSON Schema 定义，字符串参数值会自动转换为正确的类型（整数、布尔值、对象、数组）。\n"
+"- **多次调用**：单个 `<tool_call>` 块可以包含多个 `<invoke>` 块。\n"
+"- **流式输出**：工具名称和参数片段在接收 `<invoke>` 块时增量流式传输。"
+
+msgid "#### 6.3.4 Request Example (curl)"
+msgstr "#### 6.3.4 请求示例（curl）"
+

+msgstr "## 7 功能验证"
+
+msgid "### 7.1 Text"
+msgstr "### 7.1 文本"
+

+msgstr "预期结果：答案为 C。"

+msgstr "### 7.2 单张图片"

+msgid "### 7.3 Single Video"
+msgstr "### 7.3 单个视频"

+msgid ""
+"Start the service with video input enabled, for example `--limit-mm-per-"
+"prompt '{\"video\":1}'`. If the request uses `file://` local video paths, "
+"also add `--allowed-local-media-path /` or a narrower allowed directory. If "

+"本地视频路径，还需添加 `--allowed-local-media-path /` 或更窄的允许目录。如果未指定 "
+"`media_io_kwargs.video.num_frames`，vLLM 默认采样 32 帧。"
+
+msgid "### 7.4 Mixed Image and Video Request"
+msgstr "### 7.4 图像和视频混合请求"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start the service with both image and video input enabled. For the following"
+" request, use `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1,\"video\":1}'`. If the "
+"request uses `file://` local video paths, also add `--allowed-local-media-"
+"path /` or a narrower allowed directory."
+msgstr ""
+"启动服务时同时启用图像和视频输入。对于以下请求，使用 `--limit-mm-per-prompt "
+"'{\"image\":1,\"video\":1}'`。如果请求使用 `file://` 本地视频路径，还需添加 `--allowed-local-"
+"media-path /` 或更窄的允许目录。"
+

+msgid "### 8.3 Multimodal Evaluation"
+msgstr "### 8.3 多模态评估"
+
+msgid ""
+"MiniMax-M3 multimodal accuracy is evaluated with AISBench. The ViT DP path "
+"is optional and can be enabled by adding `--mm-encoder-tp-mode data` to the "
+"serving command, but it is not required for all multimodal accuracy runs. "
+"For video evaluation, if no frame count is specified in the request or "
+"evaluation config, vLLM samples 32 frames by default."
+msgstr ""
+"MiniMax-M3 多模态精度使用 AISBench 进行评估。ViT DP 路径是可选的，可通过在服务命令中添加 `--mm-encoder-tp-"
+"mode data` 来启用，但并非所有多模态精度测试都需要该路径。对于视频评估，如果请求或评估配置中未指定帧数，vLLM 默认采样 32 帧。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Video-MME results below are measured on chunk1 and chunk2, not the full "
+"dataset."
+msgstr "以下 Video-MME 结果是在 chunk1 和 chunk2 上测得的，并非完整数据集。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For Video-MME evaluation, run the vLLM OpenAI-compatible service with video "
+"input enabled and use AISBench to send the Video-MME requests. The official "
+"AISBench guide may not list Video-MME as a built-in example, so the key "
+"MiniMax-M3 settings used here are:"
+msgstr ""
+"对于 Video-MME 评估，请运行启用视频输入的 vLLM OpenAI 兼容服务，并使用 AISBench 发送 Video-MME 请求。官方 "
+"AISBench 指南可能未将 Video-MME 列为内置示例，因此此处使用的关键 MiniMax-M3 设置如下："
+
+msgid ""
+"- serve with `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"video\":1}'`;\n"
+"- do not set `media_io_kwargs.video.num_frames`, so vLLM uses the default 32 sampled frames;\n"
+"- use `max-model-len=90112` and `max_out_len=8192`;\n"
+"- evaluate Video-MME chunk1 and chunk2, not the full dataset."
+msgstr ""
+"- 使用 `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"video\":1}'` 提供服务；\n"
+"- 不设置 `media_io_kwargs.video.num_frames`，以便 vLLM 使用默认的 32 个采样帧；\n"
+"- 使用 `max-model-len=90112` 和 `max_out_len=8192`；\n"
+"- 评估 Video-MME 的 chunk1 和 chunk2，而非完整数据集。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The AISBench command used for the Video-MME chunk1+chunk2 evaluation is:"
+msgstr "用于 Video-MME chunk1+chunk2 评估的 AISBench 命令如下："
+
+msgid ""
+"`videomme_subset_1_2.py` is a local AISBench dataset config derived from the"
+" original Video-MME config, such as `videomme_gen.py`. It points `path` to "
+"the parquet file filtered from the full Video-MME metadata by the locally "
+"available chunk1/chunk2 videos, and points `video_path` to the extracted "
+"chunk1/chunk2 `.mp4` directory. This keeps the evaluation lightweight while "
+"preserving the standard Video-MME request and scoring flow."
+msgstr ""
+"`videomme_subset_1_2.py` 是一个本地 AISBench 数据集配置，源自原始 Video-MME 配置（如 "
+"`videomme_gen.py`）。它将 `path` 指向根据本地可用的 chunk1/chunk2 视频从完整 Video-MME "
+"元数据中筛选出的 parquet 文件，并将 `video_path` 指向提取的 chunk1/chunk2 `.mp4` "
+"目录。这样既保持了评估的轻量性，又保留了标准的 Video-MME 请求和评分流程。"

+"  In decode-heavy workloads, GEMM performance is often memory-bound. Weight sharding reduces per-device weight fetch volume, cutting DRAM traffic and improving bandwidth efficiency—especially for latency-sensitive layers like LM head and o_proj."
+msgstr ""
+"- **GEMM 中更快的内存访问**：  \n"
+"  在解码密集型工作负载中，GEMM 性能通常受内存限制。权重分片减少了每设备权重获取量，降低了 DRAM 流量并提高了带宽效率——尤其对于 LM 头和 o_proj 等延迟敏感层。"
+
+msgid ""
+"> ⚠️ Note:  \n"
+">\n"
+"> - `o_proj` TP is only supported in Graph mode during Decode, because dummy_run in eager mode will not trigger o_proj. It additionally requires `tensor_parallel_size == 1` (enforced at config load); see [Standard Tensor Parallelism Requirement](#standard-tensor-parallelism-requirement) below.\n"
+"> - `mlp` TP supports dense models, or dense layers in MoE models. For example, the first three dense layers of DeepSeek-R1."
+msgstr ""
+"> ⚠️ 注意：  \n"
+">\n"
+"> - `o_proj` TP 仅在 Decode 阶段的 Graph 模式下受支持，因为 eager 模式下的 dummy_run 不会触发 o_proj。此外，它要求 `tensor_parallel_size == 1`（在配置加载时强制执行）；请参阅下面的 [标准张量并行要求](#standard-tensor-parallelism-requirement)。\n"
+"> - `mlp` TP 支持稠密模型，或 MoE 模型中的稠密层。例如，DeepSeek-R1 的前三个稠密层。"
+
+msgid "### Standard Tensor Parallelism Requirement"
+msgstr "### 标准张量并行要求"
+
+msgid ""
+"Fine-grained TP shards the configured layer **across the data-parallel (DP) "
+"dimension**, not the standard tensor-parallel (TP) dimension. Its interplay "
+"with the standard `tensor_parallel_size` therefore differs per component:"
+msgstr ""
+"细粒度 TP 将配置的层**沿数据并行（DP）维度**进行分片，而非标准的张量并行（TP）维度。因此，它与标准 "
+"`tensor_parallel_size` 的交互因组件而异："
+
+msgid "| Component | Behavior with `tensor_parallel_size > 1` |"
+msgstr "| 组件 | 在 `tensor_parallel_size > 1` 时的行为 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `o_proj` | **Not supported.** The DSA attention output is reshaped with "
+"`n_local_groups = n_groups // tp_size` (standard TP), while the wo_a/wo_b "
+"weights are sharded by the OTP group (DP dimension). The two axes no longer "
+"align, so a config-time error is raised requiring `tensor_parallel_size == "
+"1`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `o_proj` | **不支持。** DSA 注意力输出使用 `n_local_groups = n_groups // tp_size`（标准 "
+"TP）进行重塑，而 wo_a/wo_b 权重由 OTP 组（DP 维度）分片。这两个轴不再对齐，因此在配置时会引发错误，要求 "
+"`tensor_parallel_size == 1`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `embedding` / LM head / `mlp` | **Supported, but only effective under "
+"`tensor_parallel_size == 1`.** All three components are sharded along the "
+"fine-grained (DP-realm) group, whose process group is built along the DP "
+"axis at a fixed `tp_idx` — orthogonal to the standard TP axis. When "
+"`tensor_parallel_size > 1`, the standard TP sharding and the fine-grained "
+"sharding operate on different axes of the rank grid and can no longer "
+"compose: the fine-grained group's ranks all share the same standard-TP "
+"weight shard, so fine-grained TP cannot deliver additional sharding. In "
+"other words, these components are designed for the all-DP "
+"(`tensor_parallel_size == 1`) decode scenario; under `tensor_parallel_size >"
+" 1` the standard TP dimension takes over and the fine-grained configuration "
+"does not take effect. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `embedding` / LM 头 / `mlp` | **支持，但仅在 `tensor_parallel_size == 1` 时有效。** "
+"这三个组件都沿细粒度（DP 域）组进行分片，其进程组沿 DP 轴在固定的 `tp_idx` 处构建——与标准 TP 轴正交。当 "
+"`tensor_parallel_size > 1` 时，标准 TP 分片和细粒度分片在 rank 网格的不同轴上操作，无法再组合：细粒度组的 rank"
+" 都共享相同的标准 TP 权重分片，因此细粒度 TP 无法提供额外的分片。换句话说，这些组件是为全 DP（`tensor_parallel_size "
+"== 1`）解码场景设计的；在 `tensor_parallel_size > 1` 时，标准 TP 维度接管，细粒度配置不生效。 |"

+msgid "vLLM Ascend provides two EPLB integration paths:"

+msgid ""

+"  and static EPLB modes."
+msgstr ""
+"- **模型运行器 V2 (MRv2)** 使用上游 vLLM EPLB 控制器、配置、策略、负载窗口和重排生命周期。Ascend 增加了 HCCL 权重传输后端和 `load_collection_phase` 扩展。\n"
+"- **模型运行器 V1 (MRv1)** 保留传统的 vLLM Ascend 动态、记录和静态 EPLB 模式。"

+"The two paths use different switches and configuration schemas. Do not mix\n"

+msgid ""
+"Select MRv2 explicitly when the model or environment does not select it by\n"
+"default. Enable expert parallelism and upstream EPLB, and set `use_async=false`.\n"
+"The upstream default is asynchronous, which is not yet supported by MRv2 on\n"

+msgid "#### MRv2 Load Collection Phase"
+msgstr "#### MRv2 负载收集阶段"
+
+msgid ""
+"`load_collection_phase` is the only MRv2 EPLB field under\n"
+"`additional_config.eplb_config`. It controls which batch phases contribute to\n"
+"the upstream load window; it does not disable routing or MoE computation for\n"
+"non-matching batches."
+msgstr ""
+"`load_collection_phase` 是 `additional_config.eplb_config` 下唯一的 MRv2 EPLB "
+"字段。它控制哪些批次阶段对上游负载窗口有贡献；它不会为不匹配的批次禁用路由或 MoE 计算。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `all` | Collect load from every batch. This is the default. | General and "
+"mixed workloads. |"
+msgstr "| `all` | 从每个批次收集负载。这是默认值。 | 通用和混合工作负载。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `prefill` | Collect only from batches containing at least one prefill "
+"request. | Optimize prefill balance and TTFT. |"
+msgstr "| `prefill` | 仅从包含至少一个 prefill 请求的批次收集。 | 优化 prefill 均衡和 TTFT。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `decode` | Collect only from batches containing decode requests and no "
+"prefill request. | Optimize decode balance and TPOT. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `decode` | 仅从包含 decode 请求且无 prefill 请求的批次收集。 | 优化 decode 均衡和 TPOT。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Classification is performed once per batch. A batch containing any prefill\n"
+"request is classified entirely as prefill; otherwise it is decode. A batch\n"
+"that does not match `load_collection_phase` does not contribute load and does\n"
+"not advance the EPLB load window. It still participates in the global EPLB\n"
+"scheduling and communication sequence so that data-parallel ranks remain\n"
+"synchronized."
+msgstr ""
+"分类对每个批次执行一次。包含任何 prefill 请求的批次整体分类为 prefill；否则为 decode。不匹配 "
+"`load_collection_phase` 的批次不贡献负载，也不推进 EPLB 负载窗口。它仍然参与全局 EPLB 调度和通信序列，以保持数据并行"
+" rank 同步。"
+
+msgid "For example, to collect only prefill load:"
+msgstr "例如，仅收集 prefill 负载："
+
+msgid ""
+"> [!IMPORTANT]\n"
+"> MRv2 currently supports synchronous EPLB only. It rejects legacy\n"
+"> `dynamic_eplb`, recording/static-map fields, `DYNAMIC_EPLB`, and\n"
+"> `EXPERT_MAP_RECORD`. It also rejects an explicitly selected communicator.\n"
+"> The initial validated execution scope is eager mode with the standard\n"

+msgstr ""
+"> [!IMPORTANT]\n"
+"> MRv2 目前仅支持同步 EPLB。它会拒绝传统的 `dynamic_eplb`、记录/静态映射字段、`DYNAMIC_EPLB` 和 `EXPERT_MAP_RECORD`。它也会拒绝显式选择的通信器。初始验证的执行范围是 eager 模式配合标准非融合 MoE 通信路径。使用前请独立验证图模式、多节点、投机解码和其他通信组合。"
+
+msgid "### Model Runner V1: Legacy EPLB"
+msgstr "### 模型运行器 V1：传统 EPLB"
+
+msgid "Legacy MRv1 EPLB has three usage modes:"
+msgstr "传统 MRv1 EPLB 有三种使用模式："

HIXL RoCE direct mode is a\n" +"sub-mode of HCCS selected by `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` on both sides and\n" +"additionally requires a reachable RoCE link:" +msgstr "" +"对于HIXL HCCS链路（具有HCCS可达性的Atlas A3），设置`--remote_h2d_link_type \"HCCS\"`和HIXL " +"buffer-" +"pool参数。`--worker_address`中的IP也用作HIXL端点IP，因此请使用可达地址，而不是`127.0.0.1`或`0.0.0.0`。HIXL" +" RoCE直连模式是HCCS的子模式，由两侧的`HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1`选择，并且还需要可达的RoCE链路：" + +msgid "#### Remote H2D link parameters" +msgstr "#### 远程H2D链路参数" + +msgid "| Parameter | Default | Description |" +msgstr "| 参数 | 默认值 | 描述 |" + +msgid "" +"| `remote_h2d_device_ids` | empty | Non-empty enables worker-side RH2D. " +"Comma-separated device IDs, e.g. `\"0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7\"`. |" +msgstr "" +"| `remote_h2d_device_ids` | 空 | " +"非空时启用工作进程侧RH2D。逗号分隔的设备ID，例如`\"0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7\"`。 |" + +msgid "" +"| `remote_h2d_link_type` | `ROCE` | Link type, case-sensitive. `ROCE` for " +"P2P-Transfer over RoCE; `HCCS` for HIXL HCCS (covers buffer-pool, HIXL RoCE " +"direct, and FabricMem sub-modes). Must correspond to the client-side " +"`remote_h2d_transport_backend` in `yuanrong.json` (`ROCE` ↔ `P2P_TRANSFER`, " +"`HCCS` ↔ `HIXL`). For `HCCS`, the client process must also export " +"`DS_RH2D_LINK_TYPE=HCCS` before starting vLLM (the backend does not export " +"it automatically); `ROCE` is the datasystem default and needs no env var. |" +msgstr "" +"| `remote_h2d_link_type` | `ROCE` | " +"链路类型，区分大小写。`ROCE`用于通过RoCE的P2P-Transfer；`HCCS`用于HIXL HCCS（涵盖buffer-pool、HIXL " +"RoCE直连和FabricMem子模式）。必须与`yuanrong.json`中客户端侧的`remote_h2d_transport_backend`对应（`ROCE`" +" ↔ `P2P_TRANSFER`，`HCCS` ↔ " +"`HIXL`）。对于`HCCS`，客户端进程还必须在启动vLLM之前导出`DS_RH2D_LINK_TYPE=HCCS`（后端不会自动导出）；`ROCE`是数据系统的默认值，无需设置环境变量。" +" |" + +msgid "" +"| `remote_h2d_hccs_buffer_pool` | `4:8` | HIXL buffer-pool parameter " +"`:`, only used when `remote_h2d_link_type=HCCS`. In containers,\n" +" mount the Ascend driver path, `npu-smi`, `hccn_tool`, `/etc/hccn.conf`,\n" +" `/etc/ascend_install.info`, and the required `/dev/davinci*` devices.\n" +"* Verify the NPU environment before enabling the client flag. The RoCE\n" +" checks below apply to `P2P_TRANSFER` and HIXL RoCE direct mode; HCCS\n" +" buffer-pool mode does not require a reachable RoCE link:" +msgstr "" +"* 确保元戎远程H2D所需的NPU驱动、固件和CANN工具包已安装，并且对工作进程可见。在容器中，挂载Ascend驱动路径、`npu-smi`、`hccn_tool`、`/etc/hccn.conf`、`/etc/ascend_install.info`以及所需的`/dev/davinci*`设备。\n" +"* 在启用客户端标志之前验证NPU环境。以下RoCE检查适用于`P2P_TRANSFER`和HIXL RoCE直连模式；HCCS缓冲池模式不需要可访问的RoCE链路：" + +msgid "" +"If these checks fail, keep `enable_remote_h2d` at `false` in `yuanrong.json`\n" +"and use the default Datasystem transfer path." +msgstr "" +"如果这些检查失败，请在`yuanrong.json`中将`enable_remote_h2d`保持为`false`，并使用默认的Datasystem传输路径。"
