@@ -0,0 +1,328 @@
+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team
+# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package.
+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-10 02:33+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-10 02:33+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# Layerwise Prefill KV Cache Offload"
+msgstr "# 分层预填充KV缓存卸载"
+
+msgid ""
+"Layerwise Prefill KV cache offload reduces the NPU memory used by KV cache on a\n"
+"dedicated Prefill node. It combines two mechanisms:"
+msgstr "分层预填充KV缓存卸载减少了专用预填充节点上KV缓存所占用的NPU内存。它结合了两种机制："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. KV cache is transferred between NPU memory and the Memcache-backed KV Pool\n"
+"   layer by layer, overlapping transfer with attention computation.\n"
+"2. Multiple logical layers reuse a smaller set of physical NPU KV cache\n"
+"   buffers. A buffer is reused only after the previous layer assigned to that\n"
+"   buffer has finished saving its KV cache."
+msgstr ""
+"1. KV缓存逐层在NPU内存和基于Memcache的KV池之间传输，使传输与注意力计算重叠。\n"
+"2. 多个逻辑层复用一组较小的物理NPU KV缓存缓冲区。只有在分配给该缓冲区的上一层完成其KV缓存保存后，该缓冲区才会被复用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This feature builds on [Layerwise KV Pool](layerwise_kv_pool.md). Read that\n"
+"guide first for the Memcache deployment, huge-page setup, and general\n"
+"AscendStore configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"此功能基于[分层KV池](layerwise_kv_pool.md)。请先阅读该指南，了解Memcache部署、大页设置和常规AscendStore配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Request-scoped partial blocks are saved and restored across scheduler steps.\n"
+"This allows shared buffers to remain enabled for non-block-aligned chunked\n"
+"Prefill. The same correctness path keeps PD-Mixed inference and Decode\n"
+"functionally compatible, but they are not target deployment scenarios for this\n"
+"feature."
+msgstr ""
+"请求作用域的局部块会在调度步骤之间保存和恢复。这使得共享缓冲区在非块对齐的分块预填充中保持启用。相同的正确性路径使PD-"
+"Mixed推理和解码在功能上保持兼容，但它们不是此功能的目标部署场景。"
+
+msgid "## Requirements"
+msgstr "## 要求"
+
+msgid "Layerwise Prefill offload currently requires:"
+msgstr "分层预填充卸载目前需要："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `AscendStoreConnector`;\n"
+"- `kv_role: \"kv_producer\"` on a dedicated Prefill node;\n"
+"- `backend: \"memcache\"`;\n"
+"- `use_layerwise: true`;\n"
+"- an MLA, SFA, or DSA attention backend with the layerwise wait/save\n"
+"  integration;\n"
+"- compatible KV cache specifications and tensor sizes for layers that share a\n"
+"  buffer;\n"
+"- eager execution; graph mode is not currently supported."
+msgstr ""
+"- `AscendStoreConnector`；\n"
+"- 专用预填充节点上的`kv_role: \"kv_producer\"`；\n"
+"- `backend: \"memcache\"`；\n"
+"- `use_layerwise: true`；\n"
+"- 具有分层等待/保存集成的MLA、SFA或DSA注意力后端；\n"
+"- 共享缓冲区的各层具有兼容的KV缓存规范和张量大小；\n"
+"- 即时执行模式；目前不支持图模式。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`kv_role: \"kv_both\"` is retained only for functional compatibility and should\n"
+"not be used with layerwise Prefill offload. During PD-Mixed inference, Decode\n"
+"must load and save the evolving KV cache through the reused buffers at every\n"
+"decoding step. The resulting layerwise transfer and synchronization overhead\n"
+"causes severe Decode performance degradation. Deploy this feature on a\n"
+"dedicated Prefill node with `kv_role: \"kv_producer\"`."
+msgstr ""
+"`kv_role: \"kv_both\"`仅为功能兼容性而保留，不应与分层预填充卸载一起使用。在PD-"
+"Mixed推理期间，解码必须在每个解码步骤通过复用的缓冲区加载和保存不断演变的KV缓存。由此产生的分层传输和同步开销会导致解码性能严重下降。请在具有`kv_role:"
+" \"kv_producer\"`的专用预填充节点上部署此功能。"
+
+msgid "## Configuration"
+msgstr "## 配置"
+
+msgid "Configure the dedicated Prefill node as follows:"
+msgstr "按如下方式配置专用预填充节点："
+
+msgid ""
+"The example keeps the first transformer layer independent and assigns all\n"
+"other layers to three reusable buffers. The values are examples rather than\n"
+"universal recommendations; choose them according to available NPU memory and\n"
+"transfer bandwidth."
+msgstr ""
+"该示例保持第一个Transformer层独立，并将所有其他层分配给三个可复用缓冲区。这些值仅为示例，并非通用建议；请根据可用的NPU内存和传输带宽进行选择。"
+
+msgid "### Core parameters"
+msgstr "### 核心参数"
+
+msgid "| Parameter | Default | Description |"
+msgstr "| 参数 | 默认值 | 描述 |"
+
+msgid "| `use_layerwise` | `false` | Enables layer-by-layer KV transfer. |"
+msgstr "| `use_layerwise` | `false` | 启用逐层KV传输。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `backend` | `\"mooncake\"` | Must be `\"memcache\"` for shared-buffer "
+"layerwise offload. |"
+msgstr "| `backend` | `\"mooncake\"` | 对于共享缓冲区分层卸载，必须为`\"memcache\"`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `layerwise_num_shared_buffers` | Number of cache-bearing layers | Number "
+"of reusable buffers assigned to non-independent layers. If omitted, no "
+"cross-layer buffer reuse is enabled. The value must be at least `1`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `layerwise_num_shared_buffers` | 缓存层数 | "
+"分配给非独立层的可复用缓冲区数量。如果省略，则不启用跨层缓冲区复用。该值必须至少为`1`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `layerwise_independent_layers` | `[0]` | Cache-bearing layers that keep "
+"dedicated buffers. Accepts a list of integers or `\"all\"`. Negative indices"
+" are resolved against all cache-bearing layers, including MTP layers. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `layerwise_independent_layers` | `[0]` | "
+"保留专用缓冲区的缓存层。接受整数列表或`\"all\"`。负索引针对所有缓存层（包括MTP层）进行解析。 |"
+
+msgid "## Buffer Layout"
+msgstr "## 缓冲区布局"
+
+msgid "For a uniform KV cache layout, let:"
+msgstr "对于统一的KV缓存布局，设："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `N` be the number of physical layers, including MTP layers;\n"
+"- `I` be the number of independent layers;\n"
+"- `R = N - I` be the number of reusable layers;\n"
+"- `B` be `layerwise_num_shared_buffers`."
+msgstr ""
+"- `N`为物理层数，包括MTP层；\n"
+"- `I`为独立层数；\n"
+"- `R = N - I`为可复用层数；\n"
+"- `B`为`layerwise_num_shared_buffers`。"
+
+msgid "The number of physical KV buffers is:"
+msgstr "物理KV缓冲区的数量为："
+
+msgid ""
+"Cross-layer reuse is active only when `R > B`. Reusable layers are assigned to\n"
+"the `B` buffers in round-robin order."
+msgstr "仅当`R > B`时，跨层复用才生效。可复用层按轮询顺序分配给`B`个缓冲区。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For example, with 27 transformer layers, independent layer `[0]`, and three\n"
+"shared buffers:"
+msgstr "例如，有27个Transformer层、独立层`[0]`和三个共享缓冲区时："
+
+msgid ""
+"Layer 4 reuses layer 1's physical buffer, layer 7 reuses layer 4's buffer, and\n"
+"so on. Before loading layer 4, the transfer thread waits until layer 1 has\n"
+"finished saving."
+msgstr "第4层复用第1层的物理缓冲区，第7层复用第4层的缓冲区，依此类推。在加载第4层之前，传输线程会等待第1层完成保存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"When cache-bearing layers have different KV cache layouts, the planner first\n"
+"groups them by their complete cache signature. Each signature gets its own\n"
+"reusable buffer pool, so incompatible layouts never share storage. The number\n"
+"of physical KV buffers is then:"
+msgstr ""
+"当缓存层具有不同的KV缓存布局时，规划器首先按完整的缓存签名对它们进行分组。每个签名拥有自己的可复用缓冲区池，因此不兼容的布局永远不会共享存储。此时物理KV缓冲区的数量为："
+
+msgid ""
+"For a uniform layout, the approximate logical-to-physical memory factor remains\n"
+"`N / (I + min(B, R))`. For heterogeneous layouts, the implementation calculates\n"
+"the factor from the actual cache page bytes assigned to every physical buffer."
+msgstr ""
+"对于统一布局，逻辑到物理内存的近似系数保持为`N / (I + min(B, "
+"R))`。对于异构布局，实现会根据分配给每个物理缓冲区的实际缓存页字节数来计算该系数。"
+
+msgid "## Request Flow"
+msgstr "## 请求流程"
+
+msgid "### Initialization"
+msgstr "### 初始化"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. The KV cache planner maps logical layer names to cache-bearing layer indices.\n"
+"2. Base transformer layers keep their normal indices. MTP layers are appended\n"
+"   after the base layers.\n"
+"3. The planner builds the complete KV cache signature of each cache-bearing\n"
+"   layer.\n"
+"4. Compatible layers are assigned to dedicated or shared physical KV buffers.\n"
+"5. Corresponding KV cache tensor descriptors assigned to the same buffer are\n"
+"   merged.\n"
+"6. The worker registers the resulting physical buffers with Memcache and\n"
+"   adjusts the logical KV cache memory budget according to the bytes saved."
+msgstr ""
+"1. KV缓存规划器将逻辑层名称映射到缓存层索引。\n"
+"2. 基础Transformer层保持其正常索引。MTP层附加在基础层之后。\n"
+"3. 规划器构建每个缓存层的完整KV缓存签名。\n"
+"4. 兼容的层被分配给专用或共享的物理KV缓冲区。\n"
+"5. 分配给同一缓冲区的相应KV缓存张量描述符被合并。\n"
+"6. Worker在Memcache中注册生成的物理缓冲区，并根据节省的字节数调整逻辑KV缓存内存预算。"
+
+msgid "### Prefill Execution"
+msgstr "### 预填充执行"
+
+msgid "During each Prefill step:"
+msgstr "在每个预填充步骤期间："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. If a request has cached KV to restore, the worker submits the required H2D\n"
+"   load before attention reaches each transformer layer.\n"
+"2. An independent layer loads only the cached portion that is not already\n"
+"   retained in HBM.\n"
+"3. A reused layer reloads its complete cached prefix because its physical\n"
+"   buffer may have been overwritten by the previous owner.\n"
+"4. Before a reused buffer is overwritten, its load waits for the previous\n"
+"   owner's D2H save to complete.\n"
+"5. Attention waits for any required layer load, writes the newly computed KV\n"
+"   cache, and opens the gate for a future prefetched layer.\n"
+"6. After the layer's KV scatter is complete, the worker dispatches its D2H\n"
+"   save. Attention computation continues while this save and later prefetches\n"
+"   run on the transfer thread."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 如果请求有需要恢复的缓存KV，工作进程会在注意力到达每个Transformer层之前提交所需的H2D加载。\n"
+"2. 独立层仅加载尚未保留在HBM中的缓存部分。\n"
+"3. 被复用的层会重新加载其完整的缓存前缀，因为其物理缓冲区可能已被前一个所有者覆盖。\n"
+"4. 在被复用的缓冲区被覆盖之前，其加载会等待前一个所有者的D2H保存完成。\n"
+"5. 注意力会等待任何所需的层加载，写入新计算的KV缓存，并为未来的预取层打开门控。\n"
+"6. 在层的KV散布完成后，工作进程会调度其D2H保存。注意力计算会继续，同时此保存和后续的预取在传输线程上运行。"
+
+msgid "## MTP and Sparse C8 Layouts"
+msgstr "## MTP和稀疏C8布局"
+
+msgid "### MTP"
+msgstr "### MTP"
+
+msgid ""
+"MTP layers use names such as `mtp.0.self_attn` and are placed after the base\n"
+"transformer layers in the physical layout. They participate in buffer\n"
+"assignment, transfer event allocation, and memory accounting."
+msgstr ""
+"MTP层使用诸如`mtp.0.self_attn`之类的名称，并在物理布局中位于基础Transformer层之后。它们参与缓冲区分配、传输事件分配和内存核算。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Because negative independent-layer indices use the complete physical layout,\n"
+"`-1` refers to the last MTP layer when MTP is enabled, not the last base\n"
+"transformer layer."
+msgstr "由于负的独立层索引使用完整的物理布局，当启用MTP时，`-1`指的是最后一个MTP层，而不是最后一个基础Transformer层。"
+
+msgid "### Sparse C8"
+msgstr "### 稀疏C8"
+
+msgid "An SFA layer can contain separate cache entries:"
+msgstr "SFA层可以包含单独的缓存条目："
+
+msgid ""
+"- the main MLA/SFA KV cache;\n"
+"- the sparse indexer cache;\n"
+"- their corresponding C8 scale data when enabled."
+msgstr ""
+"- 主要的MLA/SFA KV缓存；\n"
+"- 稀疏索引器缓存；\n"
+"- 启用时对应的C8缩放数据。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The planner does not identify these entries by model-specific names. It builds\n"
+"the physical layer's signature from their actual KV cache specifications and\n"
+"only reuses a buffer when the complete signature matches. Transfer addresses and\n"
+"allocation sizes are derived from each group's real per-layer offsets and page\n"
+"bytes. This allows MTP and sparse C8 layouts to use the same layerwise offload\n"
+"pipeline without assuming that every layer has one tensor."
+msgstr ""
+"规划器不会通过模型特定的名称来识别这些条目。它根据实际的KV缓存规格构建物理层的签名，并且仅在完整签名匹配时才复用缓冲区。传输地址和分配大小源自每个组真实的逐层偏移量和页面字节数。这使得MTP和稀疏C8布局能够使用相同的逐层卸载流水线，而无需假设每一层只有一个张量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"An incompatible layout receives a separate buffer pool instead of being\n"
+"transferred through an incorrectly sized buffer."
+msgstr "不兼容的布局会获得单独的缓冲区池，而不是通过尺寸不正确的缓冲区进行传输。"
+
+msgid "## Verification"
+msgstr "## 验证"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following log messages indicate that shared-buffer offload is active:"
+msgstr "以下日志消息表明共享缓冲区卸载已激活："
+
+msgid "If the first message is absent, check that:"
+msgstr "如果第一条消息缺失，请检查："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `backend` is `\"memcache\"`;\n"
+"- `use_layerwise` is `true`;\n"
+"- `layerwise_num_shared_buffers` is smaller than the number of reusable\n"
+"  layers;\n"
+"- all expected base and MTP layer cache specifications are present."
+msgstr ""
+"- `backend`为`\"memcache\"`；\n"
+"- `use_layerwise`为`true`；\n"
+"- `layerwise_num_shared_buffers`小于可复用层的数量；\n"
+"- 所有预期的基础和MTP层缓存规格均存在。"
+
+msgid "## Limitations"
+msgstr "## 限制"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Only the Memcache backend supports this shared-buffer layerwise path.\n"
+"- TP-size mismatch is not supported with layerwise KV transfer.\n"
+"- Context-parallel configurations have not been validated with shared-buffer\n"
+"  layerwise offload.\n"
+"- Multiple non-packed attention KV cache groups are supported. State-cache\n"
+"  groups and packed or pre-shared KV cache tensor descriptors are not\n"
+"  supported by shared-buffer reuse."
+msgstr ""
+"- 只有Memcache后端支持此共享缓冲区逐层路径。\n"
+"- 逐层KV传输不支持TP大小不匹配。\n"
+"- 上下文并行配置尚未通过共享缓冲区逐层卸载进行验证。\n"
+"- 支持多个非打包的注意力KV缓存组。共享缓冲区复用不支持状态缓存组以及打包或预共享的KV缓存张量描述符。"

new file mode 100644 @@ -0,0 +1,175 @@ +# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE. +# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team +# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package. +# FIRST AUTHOR , 2026. +# +msgid "" +msgstr "" +"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n" +"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n" +"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-10 02:33+0000\n" +"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-10 02:33+0000\n" +"Last-Translator: \n" +"Language-Team: zh_CN \n" +"Language: zh_CN\n" +"MIME-Version: 1.0\n" +"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n" +"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n" +"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n" +"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n" + +msgid "# Sparse KV Cache Offload Guide" +msgstr "# 稀疏KV缓存卸载指南" + +msgid "## Overview" +msgstr "## 概述" + +msgid "" +"This guide shows how to use Sparse KV Cache Offload, a long sequence " +"inference optimization technique." +msgstr "本指南介绍如何使用稀疏KV缓存卸载（Sparse KV Cache Offload），这是一种长序列推理优化技术。" + +msgid "" +"In long sequence inference scenario, KV cache size has become one of the " +"inference bottlenecks. Although Layerwise KV Cache Offload proposed in RFC " +"([#33398](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/33398)) can save KV " +"cache NPU memory usage during prefill, we found out that Layerwise KV Cache " +"Offload is not suitable for decode: time consumption of loading full KV " +"Cache is too long to be overlapped by decoding, leads to a significant " +"increase in TPOT." +msgstr "" +"在长序列推理场景中，KV缓存大小已成为推理瓶颈之一。尽管RFC（[#33398](https://github.com/vllm-" +"project/vllm/issues/33398)）中提出的逐层KV缓存卸载（Layerwise KV Cache " +"Offload）可以在预填充阶段节省KV缓存的NPU内存占用，但我们发现逐层KV缓存卸载不适用于解码阶段：加载完整KV缓存所需时间过长，无法被解码过程所掩盖，导致TPOT显著增加。" + +msgid "" +"To solve the problems above, we propose sparse KV cache offload, a sparse " +"attention based long sequence inference optimization technique. Take " +"[GLM-5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2) as an example, although we" +" still need to store full KV cache, only topk (2048) of them are needed in " +"sparse attention. By offloading the full KV cache to host, we are able to " +"save most of the KV Cache NPU memory usage. And since we only need to onload" +" the needed topk KV cache in each decode step, the h2d data transmission " +"size is small (about ~2MB for each batch), thus h2d loading time is " +"relatively low and make it available in decode phase." +msgstr "" +"为了解决上述问题，我们提出了稀疏KV缓存卸载（sparse KV cache " +"offload），这是一种基于稀疏注意力的长序列推理优化技术。以[GLM-5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-" +"org/GLM-5.2)为例，虽然我们仍然需要存储完整的KV缓存，但在稀疏注意力中只需要其中的topk（2048）个。通过将完整KV缓存卸载到主机端，我们能够节省大部分KV缓存的NPU内存占用。由于每个解码步骤只需加载所需的topk" +" KV缓存，h2d数据传输量较小（每个批次约~2MB），因此h2d加载时间相对较低，使其可用于解码阶段。" + +msgid "" +"For more information about Layerwise KV Cache Offload and Sparse KV Cache " +"Offload, please refer to our RFC ([#48203](https://github.com/vllm-" +"project/vllm/issues/48203))." +msgstr "" +"有关逐层KV缓存卸载和稀疏KV缓存卸载的更多信息，请参阅我们的RFC（[#48203](https://github.com/vllm-" +"project/vllm/issues/48203)）。" + +msgid "## Supported Scenarios" +msgstr "## 支持场景" + +msgid "" +"- Sparse KV Cache Offload only support sparse attention based model, such as [GLM-5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2) and [DeepSeek-V3.2](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2).\n" +"- Currently Sparse KV Cache Offload only support PD disagregate scenario, and it can be only used in D node.\n" +"- Currently Sparse KV Cache Offload only support Tensor Parallel (TP). Context Parallel (CP) and Pipeline Parallel (PP) are not supported now.\n" +"- Currently Sparse KV Cache Offload only support model_runner_v1, we will support model_runner_v2 in the future." +msgstr "" +"- 稀疏KV缓存卸载仅支持基于稀疏注意力的模型，例如[GLM-5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2)和[DeepSeek-V3.2](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2)。\n" +"- 目前稀疏KV缓存卸载仅支持PD分离场景，且只能在D节点上使用。\n" +"- 目前稀疏KV缓存卸载仅支持张量并行（TP）。暂不支持上下文并行（CP）和流水线并行（PP）。\n" +"- 目前稀疏KV缓存卸载仅支持model_runner_v1，未来将支持model_runner_v2。" + +msgid "" +"Some other features that can be used together with Sparse KV Cache Offload " +"are as follows:" +msgstr "可以与稀疏KV缓存卸载一起使用的其他功能如下：" + +msgid "| Eager | Graph | SpecDecode
(MTP) | Li C8 |" +msgstr "| Eager | Graph | SpecDecode
(MTP) | Li C8 |" + +msgid "## How to use Sparse KV Cache offload" +msgstr "## 如何使用稀疏KV缓存卸载" + +msgid "### Environment setup" +msgstr "### 环境配置" + +msgid "" +"Since some third party dependencies needed by sparse KV Cache offload are " +"not included in published images yet, you may need to install them manually " +"before using sparse KV Cache offload:" +msgstr "由于稀疏KV缓存卸载所需的一些第三方依赖尚未包含在已发布的镜像中，您可能需要在启用稀疏KV缓存卸载之前手动安装它们：" + +msgid "- Update memfabric-hybrid" +msgstr "- 更新memfabric-hybrid" + +msgid "" +"You can refer to the [memfabric installation " +"doc](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memfabric_hybrid/blob/master/doc/installation.md)" +" for more information if you encounter any problems." +msgstr "" +"如果遇到任何问题，您可以参考[memfabric安装文档](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memfabric_hybrid/blob/master/doc/installation.md)获取更多信息。" + +msgid "" +"This dependency will be removed after sparse KV cache offload related code " +"is merged to memfabric master branch." +msgstr "在稀疏KV缓存卸载相关代码合并到memfabric主分支后，此依赖将被移除。" + +msgid "" +"**NOTE:** Current memfabric_hybrid version requires NPU driver version >= " +"`25.5.1`. Use `npu-smi info` to check your driver version, you may need to " +"update it if it's version is too low." +msgstr "" +"**注意：** 当前memfabric_hybrid版本要求NPU驱动版本 >= `25.5.1`。使用`npu-smi " +"info`检查您的驱动版本，如果版本过低，您可能需要更新它。" + +msgid "- Install CPP compilation dependencies (optional)" +msgstr "- 安装CPP编译依赖（可选）" + +msgid "" +"If your image doesn't have clang installed, install clang and openmp " +"library." +msgstr "如果您的镜像未安装clang，请安装clang和openmp库。" + +msgid "" +"If your image has already installed clang, check whether openmp library is " +"already installed too. If not, install the specific version according to " +"your clang version." +msgstr "如果您的镜像已安装clang，请检查openmp库是否也已安装。如果未安装，请根据您的clang版本安装对应的特定版本。" + +msgid "" +"If your image already have clang and openmp library installed, you can skip " +"this step." +msgstr "如果您的镜像已安装clang和openmp库，则可以跳过此步骤。" + +msgid "" +"This dependency will be removed after we use custom NPU operator to replace " +"current `lru_resident_compact` and `compute_lru_resident_addrs` written by " +"cpp." +msgstr "" +"在我们使用自定义NPU算子替换当前由cpp编写的`lru_resident_compact`和`compute_lru_resident_addrs`之后，此依赖将被移除。" + +msgid "### Configuration" +msgstr "### 配置" + +msgid "" +"You can enable Sparse KV Cache Offload by setting `sparse_kv_offload_config`" +" in `additional-config`. You also need to specify `SFAPDCpuOffloadConnector`" +" in `kv-transfer-config` for PD KV transfer. Refer to the following example:" +msgstr "" +"您可以通过在`additional-config`中设置`sparse_kv_offload_config`来启用稀疏KV缓存卸载。您还需要在`kv-" +"transfer-config`中指定`SFAPDCpuOffloadConnector`以进行PD KV传输。请参考以下示例：" + +msgid "`sparse_kv_offload_config` parameters meaning and usage:" +msgstr "`sparse_kv_offload_config`参数的含义和用法：" + +msgid "" +"- `enabled` (bool, default: `False`): Whether to enable sparse KV Cache offload.\n" +"- `topk_buffer_size` (int, default: `4096`): Size of the device hot KV buffer, should be greater than the model's `index_topk`. Increase this size will increase topk KV hit rate thus reduce tpot, but will bring higher device memory usage. Normally we set it to 2 * `index_topk` to achieve a balance between topk KV hit rate and device memory usage.\n" +"- `dram_size_per_dp_GB` (bool, default: `128`): Reserved host memory size in Gigabyte per DP group. An error will be raised if this reserved size is not enough to contain the whole host KV cache buffer. All ranks in one TP group will share one host KV cache buffer, so the total host memory usage will be `dram_size_per_dp_GB` * `data_parallel_size`.\n" +"- `keep_device_kv_cache` (bool, optional, default: `False`): Whether to allocate the device KV Cache buffer. If enabled, we will still allocate device KV Cache, thus we can't save KV cache device memory usage, and can not improve sequence length or batch_size. Only reserved for PD-colocate debugging, you **SHOULD NOT** enable it in actual production environment." +msgstr "" +"- `enabled`（bool，默认值：`False`）：是否启用稀疏KV缓存卸载。\n" +"- `topk_buffer_size`（int，默认值：`4096`）：设备端热KV缓冲区大小，应大于模型的`index_topk`。增大此大小将提高topk KV命中率从而降低tpot，但会带来更高的设备内存占用。通常我们将其设置为2 * `index_topk`，以在topk KV命中率和设备内存占用之间取得平衡。\n" +"- `dram_size_per_dp_GB`（bool，默认值：`128`）：每个DP组预留的主机内存大小（以GB为单位）。如果此预留大小不足以容纳整个主机KV缓存缓冲区，将引发错误。一个TP组中的所有rank将共享一个主机KV缓存缓冲区，因此总主机内存占用将为`dram_size_per_dp_GB` * `data_parallel_size`。\n" +"- `keep_device_kv_cache`（bool，可选，默认值：`False`）：是否分配设备KV缓存缓冲区。如果启用，我们仍将分配设备KV缓存，因此无法节省KV缓存设备内存占用，也无法提高序列长度或batch_size。仅保留用于PD共置调试，您**不应**在实际生产环境中启用它。"

-msgid ""
-"- This release includes all features landed in the previous release candidates ([v0.7.1rc1](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/releases/tag/v0.7.1rc1), [v0.7.3rc1](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/releases/tag/v0.7.3rc1), [v0.7.3rc2](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/releases/tag/v0.7.3rc2)). +msgid ""
+"- The memory may be leaked and the service may be stuck after long time serving. This is a bug from TorchNPU, we'll upgrade and fix it soon.\n"
+"- The accuracy of qwen2.5 VL is not very good. This is a bug caused by CANN, we will fix it soon.\n"
+"- For long sequence input case, there is no response sometimes and the kv cache usage becomes higher. This is a bug for scheduler. We are working on it.\n"
+"- Qwen2-audio doesn't work by default, we're fixing it. Temporary solution is to set `--gpu-memory-utilization` to a suitable value, such as 0.8.\n"
+"- When running Qwen3-Next with expert parallel enabled, please set `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` environment variable to a suitable value, such as 1024.\n"
+"- The accuracy of DeepSeek3.2 with aclgraph is not correct. Temporary solution is to set cudagraph_capture_sizes to a suitable value depending on the batch size for the input."
+msgstr ""
+"- 长时间服务后可能会出现内存泄漏和服务卡住的问题。这是 TorchNPU 的一个缺陷，我们将尽快升级并修复。\n"
+"- qwen2.5 VL 的精度不是很好。这是由 CANN 引起的缺陷，我们将尽快修复。\n"
+"- 对于长序列输入场景，有时没有响应，且 kv cache 使用率会升高。这是调度器的一个缺陷，我们正在处理中。\n"
+"- Qwen2-audio 默认无法正常工作，我们正在修复。临时解决方案是将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置为合适的值，例如 0.8。\n"
+"- 在启用专家并行运行 Qwen3-Next 时，请将 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 环境变量设置为合适的值，例如 1024。\n"
+"- 使用 aclgraph 时 DeepSeek3.2 的精度不正确。临时解决方案是根据输入的 batch size 将 cudagraph_capture_sizes 设置为合适的值。"

[CI] Auto-update estimated test times in test_config.yaml (#13952)

## Summary

This PR was auto-generated by the **Update estimated test times**
[workflow](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/31373347064).

It updates the `estimated_times` values in
`.github/workflows/scripts/test_config.yaml` based on actual elapsed
times collected from CI workflow runs.

### Methodology

- Each test job uploads its elapsed time as a `timing-data-*` artifact
upon completion.
- The workflow aggregates all collected timing artifacts across jobs.
- For each test, the **median** elapsed time is computed to reduce
outlier impact.
- A **10% safety buffer** is applied and the result is rounded to the
nearest 10 seconds.

### Review Checklist

- [ ] Verify that updated `estimated_time` values are within a
reasonable range.
- [ ] Confirm no test entries are missing or unexpectedly removed.

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/0351e9aa1fdf1a51329d1906881528dfe61fc88e

[CI]Main2Main 0807 (#13477)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

#### Upgrade baseline

- Update the verified vLLM main anchor from
[`2e09247c2d7b6b97d13af6e71a85bf8d1271deb6`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/2e09247c2d7b6b97d13af6e71a85bf8d1271deb6)
to
[`58d3918e3ea0a544ffedadad2ba84559e9c51d8f`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/58d3918e3ea0a544ffedadad2ba84559e9c51d8f).
The full upstream range is available in this
[comparison](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/compare/2e09247c...58d3918e3).
- Preserve the vLLM `0.26.0` compatibility lane while adapting the main
lane to the new upstream contracts. Version gates use
`vllm_version_is("0.26.0")` and are limited to real contract
differences.
- The changes are organized in the same order as the changed files in
this PR. Each item identifies the upstream change, the downstream
adaptation, and why the adaptation is required.

#### Changes by file

##### 1. `.github/vllm-main-verified.commit`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Update anchor to `58d3918e` | Upgrade window
[0351e9aa...58d3918e](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/compare/0351e9aa...58d3918e).
| Set anchor. | Source of truth for main2main workflow. |

##### 2. `vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_fused_moe.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Version-gate FusedMoE → FusedMoEFactory rename | [vllm
#44941](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/44941) renamed
`FusedMoE` to `FusedMoEFactory`. | On main, capture and patch
`FusedMoEFactory`; on v0.26.0, also patch legacy `FusedMoE`. | Both
lanes need the Ascend runner patch at the correct binding. |

##### 3. `vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4.py` /
`vllm_ascend/models/minimax_m3/minimax_m3.py` /
`vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/fused_moe.py` /
`vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/routed_experts.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Import and use `FusedMoEFactory`; remove dead `FusedMoE` re-export |
[vllm #44941](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/44941). |
Replace `FusedMoE` with `FusedMoEFactory`. | Old symbol no longer exists
on main. Remove stale `FusedMoE` re-export from `fused_moe.py` and dead
reference in `routed_experts.py` comment. |

##### 4. `tests/ut/models/test_deepseek_v4_moe.py` /
`tests/ut/models/minimax_m3/test_minimax_m3.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Update monkeypatch target to `FusedMoEFactory` | [vllm
#44941](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/44941). | `"FusedMoE"`
→ `"FusedMoEFactory"`. | Must match the symbol imported by models. |

##### 5. `vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Version-gate `calculate_kv_scales` removal | [vllm
#49389](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49389) removed runtime
KV-scale calculation. | Add `vllm_version_is("0.26.0")` guard. | Ascend
MRV1 still supports it on v0.26.0; attribute absent on main. |
| Version-gate `clear_buffer()` removal | [vllm
#50721](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50721) removed
`clear_buffer()` from `RoutedExpertsCapturer`. | Wrap in
`vllm_version_is("0.26.0")` guard. | On main, each routed layer
overwrites current step's token rows. |

##### 6. `vllm_ascend/models/layer/attention/layer.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Remove dead `Q/K/V_SCALE_CONSTANT` references | [vllm
#49389](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49389) removed env var
registrations. Module-level constants still exist. | Remove unused
`q_range`/`k_range`/`v_range` initializations and dead `import envs`. |
Dead-code cleanup; `DSAAttention.forward()` never used these attributes.
|

##### 7. `tests/ut/patch/platform/test_deepseek_v4_thinking.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Version-gate reasoning effort expectations | [vllm
#50580](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50580) maps
`low`/`minimal`/`medium` → `low`. | `vllm_version_is("0.26.0")` guard. |
v0.26.0 keeps old mapping; main uses new. |

##### 8.
`tests/e2e/pull_request/one_card/spec_decode/test_extract_hidden_states.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enable `chunked_prefill` for hybrid model | [vllm
#50991](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50991) enabled prefix
cache by default for Mamba/hybrid models. | `False` → `True`. | Hybrid
model now requires chunked prefill. |

##### 9. `vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_vision.py` (new) +
`vllm_ascend/patch/platform/__init__.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Patch `FusedInputNorm.forward` eps=0.0 → eps=1e-5 | [vllm
#50411](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50411) added
`FusedInputNorm` with `F.batch_norm(eps=0.0)`. | Monkey-patch forward to
use `eps=1e-5`; guarded with `contextlib.suppress(ImportError)`. |
Upstream PyTorch 2.13.0 allows eps >= 0 for inference; vllm-ascend
PyTorch 2.10.0 requires eps > 0 always. Release wheels lack
`FusedInputNorm`. Remove this patch once bundled PyTorch >= 2.13.0. |

##### 10. `vllm_ascend/ops/triton/mamba/postprocess.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Add kernel signature parameters | [vllm
#50432](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50432) changed
signature. | Add `CONV_STATE_DIM_FIRST`, `HAS_IDX_MAPPING`,
`PRECOMPUTED_NEW_COMPUTED`, `state_dim_row_count/stride`,
`idx_mapping_ptr` parameters, and `num_loops` for DS conv copy. | Must
match upstream kernel contract. |

##### 11. `tests/e2e/conftest.py` /
`tests/ut/spec_decode/test_speculators_vwn_eagle3.py`
| Change | Upstream change | Downstream adaptation | Why |

+# Patch vllm's FusedInputNorm.forward to replace eps=0.0 with eps=1e-5.
+#
+# Upstream vLLM uses PyTorch 2.13.0, which requires eps > 0 for training but
+# allows eps >= 0 for inference. vllm-ascend bundles PyTorch 2.10.0, which does
+# not distinguish scenarios and requires eps > 0 in all cases. So when upstream
+# passes eps=0.0 it works fine upstream, but fails on vllm-ascend with
+# "batch_norm eps must be positive" on Ascend. This patch replaces eps to avoid
+# the error.
+
+import contextlib
+
+import torch
+
+
+def _patched_fused_input_norm_forward(self, grid_thw, visual_dtype):
+    if self.is_identity:
+        return grid_thw.to(visual_dtype)
+
+    assert grid_thw.ndim == 2
+    patches, size = grid_thw.shape
+    patch_size = size // self.channel
+
+    grid_thw = grid_thw.view(patches, self.channel, patch_size)
+    grid_thw = torch.nn.functional.batch_norm(
+        grid_thw.to(self.dtype),
+        running_mean=self.running_mean,
+        running_var=self.running_var,
+        weight=self.weight,
+        bias=self.bias,
+        training=False,
+        eps=1e-5,
+    )
+    return grid_thw.view(patches, size).to(visual_dtype)
+
+
+def install_patch():
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.vision import FusedInputNorm
+
+    FusedInputNorm.forward = _patched_fused_input_norm_forward
+
+
+with contextlib.suppress(ImportError):
+    install_patch()

[CI] Improve workflow cancellation behavior (#13949)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
GitHub Actions reevaluates job and step conditions when a workflow is
cancelled. Conditions using `always()` remain true during cancellation,
which may keep dependent jobs queued or running, especially when custom
runners or reusable workflows are involved. This can prevent
`concurrency.cancel-in-progress` and normal UI cancellation from
promptly terminating an old run.

This PR improves cancellation behavior for non-nightly workflows:

- Replaces necessary failure-handling conditions with `!cancelled()`,
allowing jobs such as artifact uploads and failure reports to run after
failures while skipping them after cancellation.
- Removes redundant `always()` conditions where jobs should only run
after their dependencies succeed.
- Updates PR tests, E2E reporting, pre-commit cache handling, Main2Main,
estimated-time updates, and weekly workflows.
- Leaves nightly workflows unchanged because some nightly jobs require
unconditional cleanup or coordination.

[Feature][MRV2] SFA model runner v2 adaptation (#13069)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR adds the missing Sparse Flash Attention (SFA) indexer support to
the Ascend Model Runner V2.

SFA models such as GLM-5 and DeepSeek-V3.2 use an additional indexer
cache besides the normal attention KV cache. The Ascend Model Runner V1
already supports this cache layout, but the corresponding Model Runner
V2 path did not
properly describe, allocate, reshape, bind, or prepare metadata for the
indexer cache.

As a result, SFA models could fail during either engine initialization
or request execution when Model Runner V2 was enabled.

This PR completes the non-C8 SFA indexer path by:

- Recognizing `DeepseekV32IndexerCache` during Model Runner V2 KV-cache
specification.
- Reusing the existing `AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec` and
`AscendSFAIndexerBackend` implementations.
- Allocating and reshaping the indexer cache as an independent
single-tensor cache.
- Reusing the existing Ascend `bind_kv_cache` implementation to bind
multiple cache modules belonging to the same model layer, including the
normal attention cache and `indexer.k_cache`.
- Passing the padded input-token count to the Ascend attention metadata
builder so that positions, slot mapping, and RoPE metadata are
consistent with the actual Model Runner V2 input.
- Keeping the existing SFA cache composition flow, which combines the
normal KV cache and indexer cache before invoking the Ascend SFA
kernels.

The implementation intentionally reuses the existing Model Runner V1 and
Ascend SFA components where possible. It does not introduce a new
cache-spec class, attention backend, cache-binding implementation, or
patch file.

Scope：This PR currently supports the non-C8 SFA indexer-cache path.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

There are no changes to the public API, CLI arguments, model
configuration, or launch scripts.

[BugFix][SFA] Guard DSA-CP graph padding sequence lengths (#13779)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This extends the DSA-CP graph-padding safeguard from
[2b1ac612496e8306c6d7d95d175e93fad90057b1](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/commit/2b1ac612496e8306c6d7d95d175e93fad90057b1)
to the equivalent metadata construction path in `sfa_v1.py`.

The SFA v1 metadata builder could calculate `seq_lens - offset` for a
graph-padding request whose global `seq_lens` is zero. When a padded
four-token slot crosses a rank-local boundary, this can produce a
negative `actual_seq_lengths_key` and pass invalid metadata to sparse
attention.

This PR:

- requires both a non-empty local request slice and a positive global
sequence length;
- clamps candidate rank-local key sequence lengths to zero;
- adds a regression test for the TP=8, graph-size=80, MTP3-style rank-6
boundary case.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No API or configuration changes.

It prevents invalid negative SFA key sequence metadata for affected
DSA-CP graph-padding layouts.

### How was this patch tested?

Added `test_dsa_cp_metadata_builder_masks_graph_padding` in
`tests/ut/attention/a2/test_sfa_v1.py`. The test reproduces the TP=8,
graph-size=80, rank-6 boundary case and verifies padded local key
sequence lengths are zero and all generated lengths are non-negative.

Local checks completed:

- `git diff --check`
- Ruff lint and format checks for both changed Python files
- codespell for both changed Python files
- Python AST syntax parsing for both changed Python files

The `torch/torch_npu` unit test was not executed on the local PC because
this repository requires NPU-dependent tests to run in an Ascend
container. Run:

```bash
pytest -sv tests/ut/attention/a2/test_sfa_v1.py::TestAscendSFAMetadataBuilder::test_dsa_cp_metadata_builder_masks_graph_padding
```

- vLLM version: v0.26.0

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/0351e9aa1fdf1a51329d1906881528dfe61fc88e
